name: DRIFT
official_title: DRIFT: Deep Restoration, ISP Fusion, and Tone-mapping
classification_basis: To combine mobile multi-frame restoration with controllable tone rendering, a perceptually trained MFP network aligns, denoises, demosaics and super-resolves RAW bursts; a separate tone-mapping network provides reference-consistent, tunable high-resolution output.

name: NPR Color Bias
official_title: Beyond Pixel Fidelity: Minimizing Perceptual Distortion and Color Bias in Night Photography Rendering
classification_basis: To reduce night-rendering color bias and perceptual artifacts, pHVI-ISPNet combines HVI-space processing, RAW features and wavelet propagation with exposure-dependent loss weights and a feature-distribution color-constancy loss.

name: RPBA-Net
official_title: RPBA-Net: An Interpretable Residual Pyramid Bilateral Affine Network for RAW-Domain ISP Enhancement
classification_basis: To make RAW enhancement interpretable and compact, predicts identity-guided residual affine corrections and pyramid bilateral grids; guide-driven adaptive slicing and cross-scale fusion jointly reconstruct color, global tone and local texture.

name: VAR-ISP
official_title: Visual Autoregressive Priors for RAW-to-sRGB Image Signal Processing
classification_basis: To exploit generative priors despite imperfect alignment and missing metadata, adapts a frozen visual-autoregressive next-scale predictor to RAW conditioning; wavelet-separated color losses supervise low-frequency tone and chromatic edges with limited trainable parameters.

name: EGUOT-ISP
official_title: Experts-Guided Unbalanced Optimal Transport for ISP Learning from Unpaired and/or Paired Data
classification_basis: To reduce dependence on paired RAW–sRGB captures, trains existing ISP architectures with unbalanced optimal transport and a committee of color, structure and frequency discriminators; supports paired or unpaired learning while discounting target-domain outliers.

name: EvRAW
official_title: EvRAW: Event-guided Structural and Color Modeling for RAW-to-sRGB Image Reconstruction
classification_basis: To reduce motion blur and color distortion in dynamic RAW-to-sRGB imaging, extracts event-motion cues with a structural-enhancement module and uses regional gamma/channel-wise color decoding; contributes pixel-aligned RAW/event data.

name: ISPDiffuser
official_title: ISPDiffuser: Learning RAW-to-sRGB Mappings with Texture-Aware Diffusion Models and Histogram-Guided Color Consistency
classification_basis: To separate texture recovery from color transfer, reconstructs grayscale detail with a texture-aware diffusion model, then maps grayscale to sRGB using histogram guidance and a color-consistency loss, reducing texture loss and color distortion.

name: RGB-Event ISP
official_title: RGB-Event ISP: The Dataset and Benchmark
classification_basis: To establish event-guided ISP evaluation, releases 3,373 pixel-aligned RAW/event captures across 24 scenes, a ColorChecker-referenced conventional pipeline, learned-ISP baselines and a simple event-guided model for studying event contributions.

name: SemiISP
official_title: SemiISP/SemiIE: Semi-Supervised Image Signal Processor and Image Enhancement Leveraging One-to-Many Mapping sRGB-to-RAW
classification_basis: To train personalized ISPs with few paired captures, learns a one-to-many sRGB-to-RAW reconstruction model and uses its synthetic pairs alongside real pairs in semi-supervised training, extending the approach to image enhancement.

name: DiR
official_title: Learning Degradation-Independent Representations for Camera ISP Pipelines
classification_basis: To generalize across compounded sensor and ISP degradations, refines a self-supervised baseline into degradation-independent representations; the learned features transfer to blind restoration, detection and instance segmentation under unfamiliar imaging conditions.

name: FourierISP
official_title: Enhancing RAW-to-sRGB with Decoupled Style Structure in Fourier Domain
classification_basis: To avoid coupling cross-camera color and spatial reconstruction, separates Fourier phase enhancement, amplitude refinement and color adaptation into three subnetworks; this lets structure and appearance be optimized independently before fusion.

name: Real-World Camera Pipeline
official_title: An End-to-End Real-World Camera Imaging Pipeline
classification_basis: To jointly handle optical distortion and compression, RealCamNet uses coordinate-aware distortion restoration for vignetting/dark shading and coordinate-independent mapping compression for tone and redundancy; introduces real captures for end-to-end rate–distortion evaluation.

name: RMFA-Net
official_title: RMFA-Net: A Neural ISP for Real RAW to RGB Image Reconstruction
classification_basis: To respect RAW sensor structure and uneven exposure, combines implicit black-level correction, a three-channel split preserving CFA detail and Retinex-based explicit tone mapping; also provides a smaller deployment variant.

name: Simple ISP
official_title: Simple Image Signal Processing using Global Context Guidance
classification_basis: To recover global illumination cues lost during patch training, adds a full-RAW global-context module to a compact neural ISP; the module can also augment other backbones to improve full-image color and tone consistency.

name: Back to the Future ISP
official_title: Back to the Future: A Night Photography Rendering ISP Without Deep Learning
classification_basis: To avoid night-ISP training-data and compute demands, constructs a shallow, explainable conventional pipeline with few parameters and no learned network; evaluates perceptual rendering through the NTIRE night-photography challenge.

name: Contrastive Subspace ISP
official_title: Deep Contrastive Patch-Based Subspace Learning for Camera Image Signal Processing
classification_basis: To handle spatially heterogeneous artifacts, PSL-AE contrastively embeds noisy/clean patches into local subspaces and trains cluster-specific decoders; replaces a uniform full-image filter with patch-dependent reconstruction.

name: Single-Frame HDR ISP
official_title: End-to-End Single-Frame Image Signal Processing for High Dynamic Range Scenes
classification_basis: To render shadows and highlights without burst capture, trains a single-frame Bayer ISP against multi-frame-merged targets; multi-head mixtures handle brightness and camera color settings using supervised, unsupervised and adversarial losses.

name: CBUnet
official_title: Rendering Nighttime Image Via Cascaded Color and Brightness Compensation
classification_basis: To model night illumination explicitly, cascades color- and brightness-compensation networks instead of learning both together; contributes NR2R, a high-resolution night RAW–RGB dataset with expert white-balance and tone annotations.

name: CRISPnet
official_title: CRISPnet: Color Rendition ISP Net
classification_basis: To match a smartphone ISP's scene-dependent color rendition, combines image metadata with classification-derived global semantics; contributes real and HDR-monitor captures spanning lighting, exposure and gain settings for color-focused ISP evaluation.

name: Day-to-Night
official_title: Day-to-Night Image Synthesis for Training Nighttime Neural ISPs
classification_basis: To reduce expensive nighttime training captures, converts daytime RAW into aligned clean/noisy nighttime pairs with controllable noise; mixing synthetic data with a small real subset trains nighttime neural ISPs.

name: Deep-FlexISP
official_title: Deep-FlexISP: A Three-Stage Framework for Night Photography Rendering
classification_basis: To decouple night-rendering noise, color and brightness, cascades RAW denoising, white balance and Bayer-to-sRGB subnetworks; weakly coupled stages simplify training and allow style adjustments through the intermediate pipeline.

name: ISPW / LiteISP-in-the-wild
official_title: Transform your Smartphone into a DSLR Camera: Learning the ISP in the Wild
classification_basis: To learn from weakly paired phone/DSLR images, combines a color-conditional ISP, parametric color alignment and a global-context Transformer predictor; a masked alignment loss excludes unreliable motion regions, alongside the new ISPW dataset.

name: RAWtoBit
official_title: RAWtoBit: A Fully End-to-end Camera ISP Network
classification_basis: To optimize rendering and compression together, learns a RAW-to-bitstream network under a rate–distortion objective; separate ISP and compression teachers distill task-specific knowledge into the joint model.

name: Shallow Night Pipeline
official_title: Shallow Camera Pipeline for Night Photography Rendering
classification_basis: To render low-light photographs with few interpretable parameters, uses local light enhancement, global histogram adjustment and stronger denoising in dark regions; the handcrafted pipeline avoids requiring explicit training targets.

name: StereoISP
official_title: StereoISP: Rethinking Image Signal Processing for Dual Camera Systems
classification_basis: To exploit a dual-camera system's additional measurements, uses inter-view disparity to combine stereo RAW inputs for joint denoising and demosaicing; evaluates the preliminary pipeline on synthesized stereo RAW pairs.

name: LiteISPNet
official_title: Learning RAW-to-sRGB Mappings with Inaccurately Aligned Supervision
classification_basis: To align cross-camera supervision despite color mismatch, jointly learns RAW-to-sRGB mapping and alignment; a target-guided global color module changes colors without moving pixels, enabling effective training of a lightweight ISP backbone.

name: AWNet
official_title: AWNet: Attentive Wavelet Network for Image ISP
classification_basis: To preserve RAW detail with efficient long-range context, combines wavelet transforms and attention with a global-context block; multiscale decomposition reconstructs texture while nonlocal features learn color mapping.

name: PyNET
official_title: Replacing Mobile Camera ISP with a Single Deep Learning Model
classification_basis: To replace hand-tuned mobile ISP stages, uses a pyramidal CNN trained progressively on smartphone RAW–DSLR pairs to learn restoration and rendering jointly; releases the 10,000-pair Zurich RAW-to-RGB dataset.

name: PyNET-CA
official_title: PyNET-CA: Enhanced PyNET with Channel Attention for End-to-End Mobile Image Signal Processing
classification_basis: To improve PyNET's feature selection and output reconstruction, adds channel attention and subpixel reconstruction modules to its pyramidal CNN; evaluates the resulting end-to-end mobile RAW-to-RGB model in the AIM learned-ISP challenge.

name: Sky Optimization
official_title: Sky Optimization: Semantically Aware Image Processing of Skies in Low-Light Photography
classification_basis: To treat noisy night skies separately, trains a low-resolution sky-segmentation network from partially annotated masks, refines and upsamples masks with a weighted guided filter, then applies sky-specific white balance, tone and noise processing.

name: CameraNet
official_title: CameraNet: A Two-Stage Framework for Effective Camera ISP Learning
classification_basis: To separate conflicting restoration and aesthetic objectives, uses two CNN modules with distinct supervision and progressive training: one restores sensor measurements, while the other learns color and appearance enhancement.

name: Deep Camera
official_title: Deep Camera: A Fully Convolutional Neural Network for Image Signal Processing
classification_basis: To reduce error accumulation in sequential ISP stages, trains a fully convolutional network end to end for defect-pixel correction, denoising, white balance, exposure, demosaicing, color transformation and gamma encoding.

name: HERN
official_title: HighEr-Resolution Network for Image Demosaicing and Enhancing
classification_basis: To exploit large patches without excessive GPU memory, combines parallel high- and low-resolution feature paths for local detail and global context; progressive training stabilizes joint demosaicing and enhancement.

name: W-Net
official_title: W-Net: Two-stage U-Net with misaligned data for raw-to-RGB mapping
classification_basis: To learn from misaligned cross-camera pairs without metadata, cascades two U-Nets and uses a loss less sensitive to alignment but sensitive to color; ensembles models trained with different losses for RAW-to-RGB reconstruction.

name: DeepISP
official_title: DeepISP: Towards Learning an End-to-End Image Processing Pipeline
classification_basis: To learn low-light restoration and rendering together, maps mosaiced RAW through local denoising/demosaicing and global color-adjustment stages; introduces paired low-/normal-light Samsung S7 data for evaluating the complete learned pipeline.

name: DPED
official_title: DSLR-Quality Photos on Mobile Devices with Deep Convolutional Networks
classification_basis: To bridge phone-to-DSLR appearance differences, trains a residual CNN with content, color and adversarial texture losses on a multi-phone paired dataset; operates on processed photographs rather than RAW sensor measurements.

name: Scene-Dependent Imaging
official_title: Modelling the Scene Dependent Imaging in Cameras with a Deep Neural Network
classification_basis: To model automatic-mode processing that varies with scene content, embeds global and local context using multiscale learnable histogram layers; learns both RAW-to-sRGB and sRGB-to-RAW mappings rather than a fixed radiometric curve.

name: Modular Neural ISP
official_title: Modular Neural Image Signal Processing
classification_basis: To expose controls hidden by monolithic neural ISPs, separates denoising, color processing, photofinishing and upsampling into replaceable learned stages; supports style-specific modules and repeated RAW re-rendering through an interactive editor.

name: ParamISP
official_title: ParamISP: Learned Forward and Inverse ISPs using Camera Parameters
classification_basis: To model ISP variations with capture settings, ParamNet embeds EXIF parameters such as ISO and exposure into control features for forward/inverse ISP networks; enables parameter-aware reconstruction, RAW editing and camera-to-camera transfer.

name: Uni-ISP
official_title: Uni-ISP: Toward Unifying the Learning of ISPs from Multiple Mobile Cameras
classification_basis: To avoid a separate neural ISP for every camera, conditions jointly learned forward/inverse mappings on device embeddings; releases synchronized FiveCam RAW–sRGB pairs and evaluates adaptation to new devices and cross-camera rendering.

name: MetaISP
official_title: MetaISP – Exploiting Global Scene Structure for Accurate Multi-Device Color Rendition
classification_basis: To reproduce device-specific color rather than only DSLR-like detail, uses cross-covariance-inspired attention for global semantics and conditions rendering on device metadata, with illuminant estimation when metadata is missing.

name: CtrlISP
official_title: CtrlISP: Rescuing Low-Light RAW Images via Controllable Neural ISP
classification_basis: To make extreme-low-light enhancement user-controllable, cascades differentiable ISP modules: DenoiseNet uses spatial interaction and guidance against dark-shading noise, while ColorNet predicts rendering parameters for adaptive color, brightness and style adjustment.

name: Fourier Unpaired ISP
official_title: Freeze the Structure, Free the Color: Fourier-Domain Training for Unpaired Smartphone ISP
classification_basis: To prevent unpaired color learning from damaging geometry, stabilizes and freezes FourierISP's structural branch, then trains color with a blurred-image ViT discriminator, inverse-cycle consistency and VGG perceptual losses under a staged curriculum.

name: Unpaired ISP Transfer
official_title: Lightweight Unpaired Smartphone ISP Transfer with Semantic Pseudo-Pairing
classification_basis: To construct supervision from unpaired RAW/RGB collections, matches DINOv2 semantic embeddings using fused Gromov–Wasserstein transport at image and patch levels; trains a 7K-parameter color CNN on these pseudo pairs.

name: Unpaired Lightweight ISP
official_title: Learned Lightweight Smartphone ISP with Unpaired Data
classification_basis: To remove pixel-aligned training requirements, trains mobile ISP backbones using multiple discriminators on pretrained feature maps and complementary losses; preserves scene content while transferring the target RGB collection's color and texture statistics.

name: CoDISP
official_title: CoDISP: Exploring Compressed Domain Camera ISP with RGB-guided Encoder
classification_basis: To reduce high-resolution multi-frame memory traffic, transfers RAW into a learned RGB-compression latent space; performs registration, denoising and demosaicing in that compact domain while retaining semantic and high-frequency information.

name: PyNET-QxQ
official_title: PyNET-QxQ: An Efficient PyNET Variant for QxQ Bayer Pattern Demosaicing in CMOS Image Sensors
classification_basis: To support nonstandard QxQ Bayer sensors within mobile budgets, reduces the pyramidal PyNET architecture and trains it with progressive knowledge distillation; preserves edge/texture reconstruction with under 2.5% of the original parameter count.

name: SYENet
official_title: SYENet: A Simple Yet Effective Network for Multiple Low-Level Vision Tasks with Real-time Performance on Mobile Device
classification_basis: To run several low-level vision tasks on mobile hardware, uses two asymmetric branches joined by a quadratic connection unit and a regression focal loss; a roughly 6K-parameter architecture handles ISP, enhancement and super-resolution.

name: LAN
official_title: LAN: Lightweight Attention-Based Network for RAW-to-RGB Smartphone Image Processing
classification_basis: To improve mobile RAW rendering without costly inference, learns the input mosaic with a convolutional layer and applies lightweight attention plus unsupervised pretraining; targets both perceptual quality and reconstruction fidelity.

name: LW-ISP
official_title: LW-ISP: A Lightweight Model with ISP and Deep Learning
classification_basis: To reduce neural-ISP deployment cost, augments a U-Net with fine-grained attention and an upsampling block; heterogeneous distillation transfers clean-image features and reconstruction knowledge from a larger teacher into the compact student.

name: MicroISP
official_title: MicroISP: Processing 32MP Photos on Mobile Devices with Deep Learning
classification_basis: To process high-resolution photographs on constrained phones, uses a scalable compact architecture compatible with mobile accelerators; releases paired mobile/medium-format Fujifilm UltraISP data and demonstrates subsecond processing of up to 32MP images on tested devices.

name: PyNET-V2 Mobile
official_title: PyNet-V2 Mobile: Efficient On-Device Photo Processing With Neural Networks
classification_basis: To enable on-device full-resolution neural ISP, redesigns the CNN for mobile operator and accelerator constraints; evaluates 12MP RAW rendering on Fujifilm UltraISP, including smartphone CPU/GPU and NPU/APU latency measurements.

name: CSANet
official_title: CSAnet: High Speed Channel Spatial Attention Network for Mobile ISP
classification_basis: To balance RAW-to-RGB fidelity and mobile speed, combines channel attention with spatial attention implemented by dilated depthwise convolution; the simplified attention module reduces inference cost for end-to-end ISP.

name: Del-Net
official_title: Del-Net: A Single-Stage Network for Mobile Camera ISP
classification_basis: To avoid sequential ISP error accumulation within a mobile budget, uses a multiscale CNN with spatial/channel attention for global color and lightweight residual attention blocks for denoising, jointly learning the RAW-to-RGB pipeline.

name: 2-Shots in the Dark
official_title: 2-Shots in the Dark: Low-Light Denoising with Minimal Data Acquisition
classification_basis: To synthesize camera-specific training noise with minimal capture effort, uses one noisy image and one dark frame per ISO: Poisson sampling models shot noise, while Fourier spectral sampling preserves signal-independent noise's spatial and statistical structure.

name: Color-Blind LL Cameras
official_title: Why Low-Light Cameras Go Color Blind: Removing Color Bias in Raw Denoising
classification_basis: To address cross-camera color shifts in blind low-light denoising, identifies black-level estimation error as a key bias source and predicts it with a global bias-estimator network, reducing dependence on camera-specific calibration.

name: GALOSH
official_title: GALOSH: Blind, Training-Free Denoising of Raw Bayer and sRGB Images by Parallel-Friendly Local Shrinkage
classification_basis: To avoid training data and expensive patch search, estimates Poisson–Gaussian noise per image, applies generalized Anscombe stabilization and local Walsh–Hadamard luminance shrinkage, then regresses chrominance from luminance; supports parallel, fixed-point RAW/sRGB denoising.

name: Nonlocal MatchFilter
official_title: Learned Nonlocal Feature Matching and Filtering for RAW Image Denoising
classification_basis: To retain interpretable self-similarity while learning RAW denoising, builds a nonlocal block performing neighbor matching, collaborative filtering and aggregation over multiscale learned features; integrates the classical patch pipeline into a trainable network.

name: PNNP
official_title: Learning Physics-Informed Noise Models from Dark Frames for Low-Light Raw Image Denoising
classification_basis: To learn sensor noise without clean/noisy pairs, trains a physics-informed neural proxy from dark frames using physics-guided noise decoupling, a physics-aware proxy model and differentiable distribution loss; also releases LRID.

name: RPG-VST
official_title: RPG-VST: Robust Poisson-Gaussian Variance Stabilization for Blind RAW Denoising
classification_basis: To stabilize blind noise calibration under outliers, fits per-CFA Poisson–Gaussian parameters with a constrained Student-t log-variance objective; a stabilized-noise reliability test selects robust or least-squares fitting before a frozen Gaussian denoiser.

name: Noise Modeling in One Hour
official_title: Noise Modeling in One Hour: Minimizing Preparation Efforts for Self-supervised Low-Light RAW Image Denoising
classification_basis: To reduce camera-specific noise-synthesis preparation, analyzes sensor-noise properties and removes explicit system-gain calibration and signal-independent-noise profiling; constructs synthetic training noise with preparation reduced from days to hours.

name: YOND
official_title: YOND: Practical Blind Raw Image Denoising Free from Camera-Specific Data Dependency
classification_basis: To denoise unknown cameras without camera-specific training, combines coarse-to-fine noise estimation, expectation-matched variance stabilization and an SNR-guided denoiser; supports both automatic strength adaptation and manual adjustment.

name: DualDn
official_title: DualDn: Dual-domain Denoising via Differentiable ISP
classification_basis: To avoid choosing between RAW detail preservation and sRGB perceptual quality, links RAW- and sRGB-domain denoisers through a differentiable ISP; jointly trains both stages and contributes the Real-Captured Camera-Independent Denoising dataset.

name: Non-parametric Noise
official_title: Non-parametric Sensor Noise Modeling and Synthesis
classification_basis: To avoid restrictive sensor-noise distributions, estimates intensity-dependent probability mass functions directly from captures and interpolates across ISO; also synthesizes additional noise when only already-noisy images are available.

name: SeNM-VAE
official_title: SeNM-VAE: Semi-Supervised Noise Modeling with Hierarchical Variational Autoencoder
classification_basis: To learn noise with limited paired data, uses a variational graphical model of clean/degraded conditional distributions and an objective combining paired/unpaired samples; synthesizes training pairs for denoising and super-resolution.

name: Contrastive LL Denoise
official_title: Contrastive Learning for Low-light Raw Denoising
classification_basis: To preserve weak high-frequency details under extreme noise, introduces denoising contrastive regularization that pulls restored features toward clean images and away from noisy inputs; a Wnet embedding extracts high-frequency cues.

name: LED
official_title: Make Explicit Calibration Implicit: Calibrate Denoiser Instead of the Noise Model
classification_basis: To adapt RAW denoisers without explicit sensor-noise calibration, pretrains with virtual cameras and implicitly calibrates the denoiser through few-pair fine-tuning; structural adjustments reduce synthetic-to-real noise mismatch without extra inference cost.

name: LLD (Physics-Guided ISO Noise)
official_title: Physics-Guided ISO-Dependent Sensor Noise Modeling for Extreme Low-Light Photography
classification_basis: To model complex noise across ISO settings, builds a normalizing flow with components guided by physical noise sources and ISO dependence; releases paired images, flat fields and bias frames for training and evaluation.

name: LRD
official_title: Towards General Low-Light Raw Noise Synthesis and Modeling
classification_basis: To capture signal-independent noise beyond simple distributions, combines physical shot-noise synthesis with a learned generative noise model and a multiscale Fourier Transformer discriminator; releases LRD for cross-sensor evaluation.

name: ELMformer
official_title: ELMformer: Efficient Raw Image Restoration with a Locally Multiplicative Transformer
classification_basis: To restore single-channel RAW efficiently, combines bidirectional fusion projection for spatial/color structure with locally multiplicative self-attention; the Transformer reduces attention cost while supporting both RAW denoising and deblurring.

name: Noise2NoiseFlow
official_title: Noise2NoiseFlow: Realistic Camera Noise Modeling without Clean Images
classification_basis: To learn realistic noise without clean references, jointly trains a Noise Flow normalizing-flow model and a denoiser using only noisy/noisy pairs; enables both noise synthesis and denoising under weak supervision.

name: PMN
official_title: Learnability Enhancement for Low-light Raw Denoising: Where Paired Real Data Meets Noise Modeling
classification_basis: To improve learnability of limited real pairs, decouples sensor noise, augments the shot-noise component and corrects dark shading; increases training variation while simplifying the mapping the denoiser must learn.

name: Pseudo-ISP
official_title: Pseudo-ISP: Learning Pseudo In-camera Signal Processing Pipeline from A Color Image Denoiser
classification_basis: To adapt sRGB denoisers to unfamiliar sensor/ISP noise, learns a pseudo ISP and RAW noise model from noisy inputs and pseudo-clean outputs, then alternates synthetic-pair generation with denoiser adaptation using unpaired clean images.

name: Rethinking Noise Synthesis
official_title: Rethinking Noise Synthesis and Modeling in Raw Denoising
classification_basis: To avoid inaccurate per-sensor parametric models, samples real sensor noise directly; pattern-aligned patch sampling preserves spatial correlations and high-bit reconstruction recovers quantization-hidden variation for realistic RAW-noise synthesis.

name: CA-NoiseGAN
official_title: Learning Camera-Aware Noise Models
classification_basis: To model noise more flexibly than fixed sensor distributions, trains a camera-aware generative adversarial noise model from real measurements; one model synthesizes distinct noise characteristics for multiple cameras and gain settings.

name: ELD
official_title: A Physics-based Noise Formation Model for Extreme Low-light Raw Denoising
classification_basis: To improve extreme-low-light synthetic training, models CMOS shot, long-tailed read, row and quantization noise with a reproducible calibration procedure; releases a multi-camera dataset to test how realistic synthesis transfers to real captures.

name: PMRID
official_title: Practical Deep Raw Image Denoising on Mobile Devices
classification_basis: To make RAW denoising mobile-friendly across ISO values, calibrates sensor-specific synthetic noise and applies a k-Sigma transform that normalizes noise variation; a compact network then handles a wide gain range with measured smartphone latency.

name: Bayer Unify Aug
official_title: Learning Raw Image Denoising with Bayer Pattern Unification and Bayer Preserving Augmentation
classification_basis: To train one denoiser across Bayer patterns without invalid RGB-style augmentations, combines BayerUnify pattern normalization and Bayer-preserving augmentation with a modified U-Net, allowing heterogeneous RAW datasets to be pooled safely.

name: NODE
official_title: NODE: Extreme Low Light Raw Image Denoising using a Noise Decomposition Network
classification_basis: To handle noise sources amplified in extreme low light, uses a multitask RAW-domain neural network that explicitly estimates defective-pixel noise alongside Gaussian read noise and Poisson shot noise before reconstructing the clean signal.

name: Noise Flow
official_title: Noise Flow: Noise Modeling with Conditional Normalizing Flows
classification_basis: To express real noise beyond Gaussian approximations, combines conditional normalizing flows with physical signal-dependent noise components; a compact model learns camera/gain-conditioned noise distributions for density estimation and synthesis.

name: SIDD
official_title: A High-Quality Denoising Dataset for Smartphone Cameras
classification_basis: To benchmark real smartphone denoising with reliable references, develops a systematic clean-ground-truth estimation procedure and collects about 30,000 noisy images from five phones and ten scenes; supplies RAW/sRGB evaluation data.

name: MeanFlow RAW
official_title: When Extreme Darkness Meets Motion Blur: MeanFlow for Unified RAW Restoration
classification_basis: To restore jointly dark and motion-blurred RAW, calibrates a shared RAW tokenizer across exposure domains and applies single-evaluation MeanFlow enhancement; physics-guided refinement and the SIDED benchmark address coupled motion/noise degradation.

name: NEC-Diff
official_title: NEC-Diff: Noise-Robust Event-RAW Complementary Diffusion for Seeing Motion in Extreme Darkness
classification_basis: To reconstruct motion under severe photon noise, uses a diffusion framework that combines complementary event and RAW measurements; contributes REAL with 47,800 pixel-aligned low-light RAW/event/reference samples spanning 0.001–0.8 lux.

name: RawMetaDiff
official_title: RawMetaDiff: Unlocking Extreme Darkness from Dual-Exposure RAW with Meta-Guided Diffusion
classification_basis: To fuse misaligned dual exposures in extreme darkness, conditions diffusion on RAW metadata: channel-wise color transfer aligns global statistics and metadata-normalized cross-attention restores shadow detail; contributes the 1K DERaw dataset.

name: DarkDiff
official_title: DarkDiff: Advancing Low-Light Raw Enhancement by Retasking Diffusion Models for Camera ISP
classification_basis: To reduce oversmoothing from pixel-regression ISPs, retasks a pretrained generative diffusion model for low-light RAW processing; transfers learned image priors into the camera pipeline to recover perceptually sharper detail and color.

name: ERIENet
official_title: ERIENet: An Efficient RAW Image Enhancement Network under Low-Light Environment
classification_basis: To accelerate low-light RAW rendering, processes scales in parallel with channel-aware residual dense convolution blocks; a green-channel guidance branch exploits Bayer sampling redundancy to aid reconstruction with lower computational cost.

name: HiMA
official_title: Hierarchical Mixing Architecture for Low-light RAW Image Enhancement
classification_basis: To balance low-light quality and efficiency, mixes channel attention and Mamba in hierarchical large/small-scale blocks; local distribution adjustment learns regional luminance/contrast statistics, while multiprior fusion maintains domain-consistent features.

name: ISP-driven LLIE Data
official_title: Towards Realistic Low-Light Image Enhancement via ISP Driven Data Modeling
classification_basis: To synthesize realistic paired low-light data, unprocesses normal-light images to RAW, adds RAW-domain degradations and varies white balance, tone and gamma during re-rendering; validates data effectiveness with a convolutional U-Net baseline.

name: LDM-ISP
official_title: LDM-ISP: Enhancing Neural ISP for Low Light with Latent Diffusion Models
classification_basis: To reuse pretrained diffusion priors for extremely dark RAW, trains lightweight modules that modulate U-Net features with RAW cues; separates low-frequency latent generation from high-frequency preservation during decoding.

name: Reconstruction & Denoising in the Dark
official_title: Rethinking Reconstruction and Denoising in the Dark: New Perspective, General Architecture and Beyond
classification_basis: To avoid weak coupling between restoration tasks, shares a chromaticity/noise-aware backbone with compact reconstruction and denoising heads; task-specific supervision and dual-head interaction exchange information beyond image-level cascades.

name: Rectified-Flow LL RAW
official_title: Physics-Guided Rectified Flow for Low-light RAW Image Enhancement
classification_basis: To capture spatial sensor-noise variation, combines additive/multiplicative physical noise with per-pixel calibration and synthesis, then trains a physics-guided rectified-flow enhancer; contributes the Sony A7S II indoor LLID benchmark.

name: SIED
official_title: Learning to See in the Extremely Dark
classification_basis: To study illumination down to 0.0001 lux, synthesizes calibrated paired RAW/sRGB data at three light ranges; a diffusion enhancer with adaptive illumination correction and color-consistency loss addresses extreme-noise exposure and color recovery.

name: TS-Diff
official_title: TS-Diff: Two-Stage Diffusion Model for Low-Light RAW Image Enhancement
classification_basis: To adapt diffusion enhancement across cameras, pretrains camera-feature-integration modules on virtual sensors, averages and fine-tunes them on limited target RAW data; a color corrector dynamically aligns global color distributions during diffusion.

name: Retinex-RAWMamba
official_title: Retinex-RAWMamba: Bridging Demosaicing and Denoising for Low-Light RAW Image Enhancement
classification_basis: To jointly handle RAW noise, demosaicing and nonlinear exposure, introduces a CFA-aware Mamba architecture and a Retinex decomposition module; decouples illumination and reflectance to reduce reliance on manually chosen linear amplification.

name: DiffuseRAW
official_title: DiffuseRAW: End-to-End Generative RAW Image Processing for Low-Light Images
classification_basis: To use generative priors before lossy ISP processing, fine-tunes a pretrained latent diffusion model directly on low-light RAW to generate long-exposure-like processed images; learns the RAW-to-output pipeline end to end.

name: DNF
official_title: DNF: Decouple and Feedback Network for Seeing in the Dark
classification_basis: To resolve ambiguity between noise removal and color mapping, decouples RAW-domain denoising from sRGB reconstruction and feeds features back across stages; avoids information loss caused by passing only intermediate images.

name: ExposureDiffusion
official_title: ExposureDiffusion: Learning to Expose for Low-light Image Enhancement
classification_basis: To avoid starting enhancement from pure noise, embeds a physical exposure process into diffusion and iteratively restores the noisy input; an adaptive residual layer suppresses overcorrection once regions become well exposed.

name: FDA Low-Light
official_title: Learning to See Low-Light Images via Feature Domain Adaptation
classification_basis: To decouple noise removal and color mapping at single-stage cost, supervises the encoder with clean RAW and adapts features through a line-buffer-friendly Lineformer; removes the RAW supervision branch at inference.

name: MCR
official_title: Abandoning the Bayer-Filter to See in the Dark
classification_basis: To exploit monochrome sensitivity without a second sensor at inference, learns a De-Bayer-Filter simulator and fuses synthesized monochrome with color RAW using channel attention; contributes real monochrome/color paired MCR data.

name: Progressive LL RAW
official_title: Progressive Joint Low-light Enhancement and Noise Removal for Raw Images
classification_basis: To adapt joint brightness, color and denoising across cameras with less recollection, combines a coefficient-estimation branch and a joint enhancement/denoising branch; targets camera-specific processing of high-resolution RAW images.

name: RAW LLE (TIP)
official_title: Towards Low Light Enhancement with RAW Images
classification_basis: To identify which RAW properties benefit enhancement, introduces a factorized enhancement model for controlled evaluation; REENet learns to exploit RAW during training while supporting sRGB-only input at test time.

name: Burst Dark Enhancement
official_title: Burst Photography for Learning to Enhance Extremely Dark Images
classification_basis: To recover detail from extremely dark bursts, first predicts low-resolution clean RAW, then refines textures in a fine network; permutation-invariant feature fusion combines multiple frames without depending on their input order.

name: Few-Shot LL RAW
official_title: Few-Shot Domain Adaptation for Low Light RAW Image Enhancement
classification_basis: To transfer low-light enhancement to a new camera, combines labeled source-camera data with ten or fewer labeled target examples through few-shot domain adaptation; contributes paired short/long-exposure Nikon data for cross-camera testing.

name: RED
official_title: Restoring Extremely Dark Images in Real Time
classification_basis: To restore dark images with low latency, concentrates computation in coarse scale spaces and processes scales concurrently; an input-only amplifier estimates exposure gain, reducing reliance on externally supplied amplification factors.

name: Adaptive Low-Light RAW
official_title: Learning an Adaptive Model for Extreme Low-light Raw Image Processing
classification_basis: To avoid manually setting RAW amplification, predicts a scene-dependent target exposure with a brightness-prediction module and renders it through exposure shifting; introduces an image-enhancement vector and Campus Image Dataset for supervision.

name: EEMEFN
official_title: EEMEFN: Low-Light Image Enhancement via Edge-Enhanced Multi-Exposure Fusion Network
classification_basis: To recover detail from a single extremely dark RAW, synthesizes multiple exposure representations, fuses their complementary features and uses edge-enhanced refinement; combines exposure handling and boundary reconstruction in one enhancement framework.

name: LLPackNet
official_title: Towards Fast and Light-Weight Restoration of Dark Images
classification_basis: To accelerate dark-image restoration, packs features into low-resolution representations for most computation and unpacks the output; estimates amplification from the input, reducing both inference cost and manual exposure configuration.

name: Short/Long Raw Pairs
official_title: Low-light Image Restoration with Short- and Long-exposure Raw Pairs
classification_basis: To combine sharp but noisy short exposure with clean but blurred long exposure, synthesizes realistic paired RAW degradations and trains LSFNet for alignment-aware fusion; jointly handles motion blur, noise and color distortion.

name: Low-Light Camera Pipeline
official_title: Learning Digital Camera Pipeline for Extreme Low-Light Imaging
classification_basis: To learn well-exposed rendering from short-exposure RAW, trains a neural camera pipeline with a loss combining pixelwise and perceptual properties; evaluates both numerical fidelity and human visual preference under extreme low light.

name: Moving Objects in the Dark
official_title: Learning to See Moving Objects in the Dark
classification_basis: To obtain real supervision for moving low-light scenes, captures synchronized bright/dark videos with an optical splitting system; a fully convolutional model mixing 2D and 3D operations learns RAW-to-RGB spatiotemporal enhancement.

name: Seeing Motion in the Dark
official_title: Seeing Motion in the Dark
classification_basis: To train low-light video without dynamic long-exposure references, uses paired static RAW videos and a siamese network with temporal-stability loss; the learned pipeline generalizes to moving scenes in the released DRV benchmark.

name: SID
official_title: Learning to See in the Dark
classification_basis: To replace failing conventional processing at extreme low SNR, trains a fully convolutional U-Net directly from short-exposure RAW to long-exposure sRGB references; releases paired Sony/Fuji captures establishing a reproducible low-light benchmark.

name: RIECR
official_title: Unified RAW Image Exposure Correction and Restoration via Linear Illumination and Frequency-Adaptive Enhancement
classification_basis: To restore both under- and overexposed RAW, predicts channel-aware linear gains with LICN and applies a dual-branch frequency network with dynamic convolution; contributes 1,784 real pairs spanning 223 scenes.

name: JD3Net
official_title: Efficient Deep Demosaicing with Spatially Downsampled Isotropic Networks
classification_basis: To reduce demosaicing cost, spatially downsamples before an isotropic fully convolutional network designed with mathematical architecture search; evaluates the efficiency/quality trade-off on demosaicing and joint denoising tasks.

name: Pixel-bin Unified Demosaic
official_title: An Extensible and Lightweight Unified Architecture for Demosaicing Pixel-bin Image Sensors
classification_basis: To avoid separate networks for each pixel-bin CFA, uses a modular lightweight shared demosaicing architecture and a training-free CFA identifier; supports extensible handling of Quad, Nona and related sensor layouts.

name: R3 Bayer Deraining
official_title: R3: Reconstruction, Raw, and Rain: Deraining Directly in the Bayer Domain
classification_basis: To avoid irreversible ISP mixing during deraining, reconstructs directly from Bayer mosaics before rendering; introduces matched-bit-depth RAW/sRGB rainy captures and a color-invariant Information Conservation Score for evaluation.

name: SegDem
official_title: SegDem: Segmentation helps Demosaicing
classification_basis: To transfer scene structure into demosaicing, pretrains region/boundary representations with instance segmentation and transfers the decoder to RAW reconstruction; evaluates this strategy with CNN, Transformer and state-space backbones across Single/Quad Bayer.

name: Smartphone RAW Degradation
official_title: RAW-Domain Degradation Models for Realistic Smartphone Super-Resolution
classification_basis: To reduce synthetic-to-real SR mismatch, calibrates device-specific blur/noise and unprocesses rendered images into smartphone RAW; trains mosaicked-RAW super-resolution and evaluates real captures from a held-out device.

name: Structural Guidance JDD
official_title: Structural Guidance for Unified Joint Demosaicing and Denoising
classification_basis: To guide noisy sparse-CFA restoration with pretrained structure, encodes mosaic, CFA masks and noise level as a unified observation; a trainable adapter bridges domains before residual fusion of structural and restoration features.

name: ASRD
official_title: Learning Arbitrary-Scale RAW Image Downscaling with Wavelet-based Recurrent Reconstruction
classification_basis: To downscale RAW at arbitrary factors without losing structure, recurrently reconstructs wavelet low/high-frequency bands with separate scaling and prediction modules; adds an energy loss and a real noninteger-scale benchmark.

name: BMTNet
official_title: Binarized Mamba-Transformer for Lightweight Quad Bayer HybridEVS Demosaicing
classification_basis: To demosaic Quad Bayer HybridEVS efficiently, combines binarized Mamba projections with Swin Transformer blocks while keeping selective scanning full precision; captures global/local dependencies with lower edge-device compute.

name: Camera-Specific RAW SR Sim
official_title: Camera-Specific Imaging Simulation for Raw Domain Image Super Resolution
classification_basis: To supply camera-matched RAW SR pairs, accelerates physical simulation through subgraph decomposition; LatentKAN combines stage-supervised iterative feature fusion and learnable Kolmogorov–Arnold activations to reduce spectral bias.

name: DSDNet
official_title: DSDNet: Raw Domain Demoiréing via Dual Color-Space Synergy
classification_basis: To remove moiré while preserving color, fuses RAW and YCbCr streams with dynamically modulated synergic attention; a luminance–chrominance adaptive Transformer separates brightness and color representations for more targeted correction.

name: FrENet
official_title: Efficient RAW Image Deblurring with Adaptive Frequency Modulation
classification_basis: To deblur RAW efficiently, processes frequency-domain features and adaptively modulates components by spectral position; targets RAW-to-RAW restoration while allowing the same design to extend to sRGB deblurring.

name: QB HybridEVS SSM
official_title: Lightweight Quad Bayer HybridEVS Demosaicing via State Space Augmented Cross-Attention
classification_basis: To separate event-pixel holes from demosaicing, TSANet first inpaints then reconstructs color; a Cross-Swin State Block combines positional priors, cross-attention and linear-complexity state-space modeling for lightweight HybridEVS processing.

name: QRNet
official_title: Modeling Dual-Exposure Quad-Bayer Patterns for Joint Denoising and Deblurring
classification_basis: To combine short-exposure sharpness and long-exposure low noise within a sensor, models dual-exposure Quad Bayer acquisition and trains a hierarchical CNN; B2QB synthesis converts Bayer data into training observations.

name: Quad/Nona JDD
official_title: Examining Joint Demosaicing and Denoising for Single-, Quad-, and Nona-Bayer Patterns
classification_basis: To compare CFA-dependent joint restoration, benchmarks Single/Quad/Nona Bayer under a common denoising/demosaicing setup; introduces maskout training for dead pixels and a 638-image challenging RAW demosaicing dataset.

name: RAW Reflection Removal
official_title: Removing Reflections from RAW Photos
classification_basis: To separate real reflections using linear image formation, trains on photometrically/geometrically simulated RAW mixtures with optional opposite-view context; a low-resolution separation model and learned upsampler reconstruct full-resolution layers.

name: RawNIND
official_title: Learning Joint Denoising, Demosaicing, and Compression from the Raw Natural Image Noise Dataset
classification_basis: To support sensor- and rendering-flexible denoising, releases paired natural RAW images and compares Bayer versus linear-RGB restoration; jointly learning RAW denoising/compression improves rate–distortion efficiency while preserving later editing freedom.

name: RDDM
official_title: RDDM: Practicing RAW Domain Diffusion Model for Real-world Image Restoration
classification_basis: To transfer diffusion restoration across RAW distributions, introduces a RAW VAE mapping into enhanced linear images and configurable multi-Bayer LoRA; a scalable sRGB-to-RAW synthesis pipeline supplies low/high-quality training pairs.

name: Train on RAW & HDR
official_title: Training Neural Networks on RAW and HDR Images for Restoration Tasks
classification_basis: To choose effective training representations for high-dynamic-range signals, compares linear-space losses with PQ, PU21 and μ-law display encodings across denoising, deblurring and SR; identifies the benefit of perceptually uniform encodings.

name: BSRAW
official_title: BSRAW: Improving Blind RAW Image Super-Resolution
classification_basis: To improve blind RAW super-resolution in real scenes, synthesizes sensor noise, defocus and exposure degradations before ISP nonlinearities; trains sensor-domain models and contributes a DSLM dataset for real-capture benchmarking.

name: Combine DM & DN
official_title: How to Best Combine Demosaicing and Denoising?
classification_basis: To determine low-complexity restoration order, analyzes demosaiced-noise statistics and compares staged pipelines; recommends adapted post-demosaic denoising at moderate noise and partial pre-denoising plus a second denoiser at high noise.

name: DemosaicFormer
official_title: DemosaicFormer: Coarse-to-Fine Demosaicing Network for HybridEVS Camera
classification_basis: To restore HybridEVS color and defective pixels, cascades coarse demosaicing and pixel correction; a multiscale gating module exchanges features across resolutions for coarse-to-fine reconstruction.

name: DREUDC
official_title: Panel-Specific Degradation Representation for Raw Under-Display Camera Image Restoration
classification_basis: To account for panel-dependent under-display degradation, learns implicit OLED-panel representations with unsupervised triplet loss and conditions an efficient restoration Transformer on them; contributes aligned sensor-level real UDC captures.

name: Efficient Blind RAW Restoration
official_title: Toward Efficient Deep Blind Raw Image Restoration
classification_basis: To generalize blind restoration across cameras, simulates realistic sensor noise, motion blur and camera shake in RAW and trains on multiple sensors; restores detail before nonlinear ISP processing complicates the degradations.

name: RBSFormer
official_title: RBSFormer: Enhanced Transformer Network for Raw Image Super-Resolution
classification_basis: To super-resolve RAW before complex ISP artifacts arise, enhances a Transformer with cross-covariance attention and gated feed-forward blocks; RAW augmentation and hybrid ensembling improve reconstruction under a compact parameter budget.

name: RRID
official_title: Image Demoireing in RAW and sRGB Domains
classification_basis: To exploit complementary moiré cues, jointly processes RAW and sRGB using gated-feedback and frequency-selection skip modules; an RGB-guided learned ISP restores camera-dependent color after feature-level demoiréing.

name: Inheriting Bayer's Legacy
official_title: Inheriting Bayer's Legacy: Joint Remosaicing and Denoising for Quad Bayer Image Sensor
classification_basis: To reuse Bayer ISPs with Quad Bayer sensors, jointly remosaics and denoises without resolution loss using a dual-head network, Swin-based denoising and wavelet processing; hard-patch post-training targets moiré/zipper failures.

name: JDD Double DIP
official_title: Joint Demosaicing and Denoising with Double Deep Image Priors
classification_basis: To jointly denoise and demosaic without external training data, optimizes two deep-image-prior networks on a single RAW observation; evaluates reconstruction across multiple noise types and intensities.

name: JDD Two-stage
official_title: Joint Demosaicking and Denoising Benefits from a Two-stage Training Strategy
classification_basis: To preserve observed CFA values and stabilize learning, first trains a traditional-plus-residual-CNN demosaicer on clean data, then trains a second CNN on demosaiced noise; compares this staged strategy with joint end-to-end training.

name: Moiré-Free Demosaick
official_title: Toward Moiré-Free and Detail-Preserving Demosaicking
classification_basis: To reduce moiré without oversmoothing detail, separates spectral and spatial feature aggregation; strengthens global cross-color communication while retaining local spatial contrast for demosaicing and joint denoising.

name: RAW Rain Removal
official_title: End-to-end Rain Streak Removal with RAW Images
classification_basis: To avoid ISP information loss before deraining, jointly learns rain removal and RAW processing; synthesizes rain streaks in RAW space and tests transfer across cameras and rendering pipelines.

name: SDAT
official_title: SDAT: Sub-Dataset Alternation Training for Improved Image Demosaicing
classification_basis: To reduce demosaicing dataset bias without changing architecture, partitions training data into differently biased subsets and alternates them during optimization; evaluates the protocol across several reconstruction backbones.

name: Unified Demosaicing (KD)
official_title: Efficient Unified Demosaicing for Bayer and Non-Bayer Patterned Image Sensors
classification_basis: To share demosaicing across Bayer and non-Bayer sensors, KLAP adapts only a small set of CFA-specific filters; its inference-time meta-learning variant addresses unknown artifacts in real sensor data.

name: VD_raw
official_title: Recaptured Raw Screen Image and Video Demoiréing via Channel and Spatial Modulations
classification_basis: To exploit simpler channel-dependent RAW moiré, combines color-separated and color-mixed branches through channel/spatial modulation; introduces aligned RAW-video data and alternating-pattern-based temporal alignment.

name: CDLNet
official_title: CDLNet: Noise-Adaptive Convolutional Dictionary Learning Network for Blind Denoising and Demosaicing
classification_basis: To retain interpretability and noise adaptation, unfolds convolutional dictionary learning into a trainable network for denoising and joint demosaicing; evaluates small/large models and unsupervised training.

name: RSTCANet
official_title: Residual Swin Transformer Channel Attention Network for Image Demosaicing
classification_basis: To combine spatial attention with color-channel interactions, stacks residual Swin Transformer blocks and inserts channel attention between consecutive blocks; targets compact demosaicing with fewer trainable parameters.

name: TENet
official_title: Rethinking Learning-based Demosaicing, Denoising, and Super-Resolution Pipeline
classification_basis: To determine how restoration order affects quality, compares denoising/demosaicing/SR pipelines and embeds intermediate supervision through detachable heads; recommends DN→SR→DM and contributes PixelShift200 for evaluation.

name: BJDD / PIPNet
official_title: Beyond Joint Demosaicking and Denoising: An Image Processing Pipeline for a Pixel-bin Image Sensor
classification_basis: To reconstruct noisy pixel-bin sensor images, combines depth/spatial attention with perceptual losses for joint denoising and demosaicing; extends the network into a smartphone reconstruction and enhancement pipeline.

name: ISP-Agnostic UDC
official_title: ISP-Agnostic Image Reconstruction for Under-Display Cameras
classification_basis: To restore under-display images without fixing their appearance, operates before the legacy ISP and preserves its rendering freedom; uses an HDR-monitor capture/augmentation protocol to obtain diverse high-contrast real training data.

name: JDD in the Wild
official_title: Joint Demosaicking and Denoising in the Wild: The Case of Training Under Ground Truth Uncertainty
classification_basis: To train despite imperfect clean targets, models ground-truth uncertainty with a two-stage probabilistic degradation and conjugate prior, optimizing an ELBO; a weak-prior fine-tuning scheme improves out-of-distribution joint restoration.

name: JDNDMSR
official_title: End-to-End Learning for Joint Image Demosaicing, Denoising and Super-Resolution
classification_basis: To avoid accumulated errors across three restoration stages, trains a single CNN jointly for denoising, demosaicing and super-resolution; compares task combinations and losses, including mean absolute error supervision.

name: Joint DM + HDR
official_title: Deep Joint Demosaicing and High Dynamic Range Imaging within a Single Shot
classification_basis: To recover full-color HDR from sparse spatially varying exposures, uses spatially varying convolution for Bayer structure and exposure guidance against clipped/dark pixels; jointly optimizes demosaicing and single-shot HDR reconstruction.

name: Jointly Deblur-Demosaick-Denoise
official_title: Learning to Jointly Deblur, Demosaick and Denoise Raw Images
classification_basis: To avoid separate-stage artifacts with known blur, introduces an interpretable joint demosaicing/deblurring module and trains on realistically unprocessed RAW; also corrects color-dependent optical point-spread blur in real captures.

name: SAGAN (Nona-Bayer)
official_title: SAGAN: Adversarial Spatial-asymmetric Attention for Noisy Nona-Bayer Reconstruction
classification_basis: To suppress Nona-Bayer reconstruction artifacts, combines spatial-asymmetric attention for bidirectional transformation and large-kernel global context with adversarial learning; jointly denoises and reconstructs full-color output.

name: DM-or-DN First
official_title: A Review of an Old Dilemma: Demosaicking First, or Denoising First?
classification_basis: To resolve restoration-order choices, reviews and benchmarks noisy-mosaic pipelines and analyzes demosaiced noise; specifies how classic denoisers must be adapted when demosaicing precedes denoising.

name: JDSR
official_title: Joint Demosaicing and Super-Resolution (JDSR): Network Design and Perceptual Optimization
classification_basis: To combine CFA reconstruction and upscaling perceptually, uses a predemosaicer plus residual-dense squeeze-and-excitation blocks; a relativistic discriminator and pre-excitation perceptual loss improve textured-region reconstruction.

name: Raw Image Deblurring
official_title: Raw Image Deblurring
classification_basis: To study deblurring before nonlinear rendering, introduces paired RAW/processed Deblur-RAW data and a RAW-oriented restoration network; evaluates sensor transfer and the benefit of RAW training for existing models.

name: SGNet (JDD)
official_title: Joint Demosaicing and Denoising with Self Guidance
classification_basis: To exploit Bayer's denser green sampling, first estimates green and uses it to guide missing-color recovery; density-map guidance handles varying spatial frequencies and extends joint restoration to super-resolution.

name: Deep Demosaicing for Edge
official_title: Deep Demosaicing for Edge Implementation
classification_basis: To reduce edge-device demosaicing cost while controlling zipper/false-color artifacts, develops a compact deep reconstruction model and analyzes artifact formation; evaluates reconstruction accuracy against computational requirements.

name: JDD Burst Fine-tune
official_title: Joint Demosaicking and Denoising by Fine-Tuning of Bursts of Raw Images
classification_basis: To bridge synthetic-training and real-sensor noise, learns joint demosaicing/denoising directly from mosaicked bursts without RGB truth; burst-specific self-supervised fine-tuning adapts the CNN to each capture.

name: Real Scene SR with Raw
official_title: Towards Real Scene Super-Resolution with Raw Images
classification_basis: To reduce realistic-degradation mismatch and lost radiance, simulates camera formation for training and uses a dual CNN on RAW; spatially varying color transformation restores local color after super-resolution.

name: Zoom to Learn
official_title: Zoom to Learn, Learn to Zoom
classification_basis: To train real computational zoom despite imperfect alignment, captures optical-zoom RAW reference pairs in SR-RAW and introduces contextual bilateral loss; trains a deep model robust to small input/target displacements.

name: DMCNN
official_title: Learning Deep Convolutional Networks for Demosaicing
classification_basis: To learn reconstruction for flexible CFA layouts, trains deep CNN demosaicers and jointly optimizes CFA design with reconstruction; extends evaluation to spatially varying exposure/color for single-shot HDR.

name: Kokkinos Demosaick
official_title: Deep Image Demosaicking using a Cascade of Convolutional Residual Denoising Networks
classification_basis: To make joint restoration interpretable and data-efficient, unrolls a regularized optimization process into cascaded convolutional residual denoisers; learns the prior while retaining an explicit iterative demosaicing structure.

name: Residual JDSR
official_title: Deep Residual Network for Joint Demosaicing and Super-Resolution
classification_basis: To avoid amplifying demosaicing artifacts during upscaling, trains a residual CNN directly from low-resolution Bayer mosaics to high-resolution RGB; jointly solves missing colors and spatial detail in one step.

name: DemosaicNet
official_title: Deep Joint Demosaicking and Denoising
classification_basis: To train robust joint denoising/demosaicing, mines difficult reconstruction examples at scale and learns a convolutional model from noisy mosaics; supports both Bayer and X-Trans sensor layouts.

name: BRACE
official_title: Bricker to BRACE: A Bracket Exposure RAW Dataset and Restoration Model for Flicker-Banding
classification_basis: To remove exposure-dependent flicker bands, fuses bracketed RAW with a frequency-aware prior and multiscale spatial cross-attention; contributes synthetic/real Bricker captures and a stripe-frequency consistency metric.

name: BurstGP
official_title: BurstGP: Enhancing Raw Burst Image Super Resolution with Generative Priors
classification_basis: To add realistic texture to burst SR, augments a conventional reconstructor with multiframe diffusion priors, degradation-aware conditioning and an sRGB-to-linear inverter; controls generative detail while retaining linear-domain fidelity.

name: DEBIR
official_title: Dynamic Exposure Burst Image Restoration
classification_basis: To adapt burst acquisition to motion and lighting, BAENet predicts per-frame exposure from a preview, motion and gain; a differentiable burst simulator and staged training jointly optimize capture and restoration.

name: GenMFSR
official_title: GenMFSR: Generative Multi-Frame Image Restoration and Super-Resolution
classification_basis: To use foundation-model priors for multiframe RAW reconstruction, aligns burst measurements and constrains generation to high-frequency RAW regions; jointly performs denoising, demosaicing and super-resolution while limiting low-frequency artifacts.

name: Keyframe SSM Burst SR
official_title: Keyframe-Centric State-Space Modeling for Burst Image Super-Resolution
classification_basis: To scale burst SR efficiently, concentrates reconstruction compute on the keyframe and extracts subpixel priors through Gather–Aggregate–Scatter transfer; wavelet-conditioned state-space routing emphasizes high-frequency information while preserving native-view features.

name: LatentBurst
official_title: LatentBurst: A Fast and Efficient Multi Frame Super-Resolution for Hexadeca-Bayer Pattern CIS images
classification_basis: To reconstruct Hexadeca-Bayer bursts on mobile hardware, uses latent pyramid alignment/fusion and an efficient U-Net; optical-flow fine-tuning and two-step distillation address motion and synthetic-to-real domain gaps.

name: QMambaBSR
official_title: QMambaBSR: Burst Image Super-Resolution with Query State Space Model
classification_basis: To distinguish consistent subpixel detail from random burst noise, combines interframe queries with intraframe state-space scanning; adaptive upsampling predicts kernels from the recovered subpixel distribution for scene-dependent reconstruction.

name: Bracket Restoration
official_title: Improving Bracket Image Restoration and Enhancement with Flow-guided Alignment and Enhanced Feature Aggregation
classification_basis: To align noisy blurred exposures, IREANet guides deformable alignment and spatial attention with optical flow; recurrent enhanced residual aggregation merges aligned features, with Bayer-preserving augmentation for robust RAW training.

name: BurstM
official_title: BurstM: Deep Burst Multi-scale SR using Fourier Space with Optical Flow
classification_basis: To support flexible-scale burst SR, estimates optical flow for frame alignment and continuous Fourier coefficients for high-frequency textures; one model reconstructs several output scale factors.

name: Burstormer
official_title: Burstormer: Burst Image Restoration and Enhancement Transformer
classification_basis: To exchange information under complex burst motion, uses a Transformer with deformable alignment, reference-feature enrichment and cyclic burst sampling; progressively fuses local/nonlocal context before upsampling.

name: Efficient Raw HDR
official_title: Efficient HDR Reconstruction from Real-World Raw Images
classification_basis: To deploy RAW HDR reconstruction efficiently, RepUNet uses structural reparameterization and a motion-alignment loss against ghosting; contributes the RealRaw-HDR data-formation pipeline and real-capture benchmark.

name: FBANet
official_title: Towards Real-World Burst Image Super-Resolution: Benchmark and Method
classification_basis: To aggregate real bursts without dense pixelwise alignment, combines homography registration with federated affinity fusion; contributes RealBSR-RAW/RGB data for studying real degradation and complementary interframe detail.

name: GMTNet
official_title: Gated Multi-Resolution Transfer Network for Burst Restoration and Enhancement
classification_basis: To reconstruct precise detail from degraded bursts, combines multiscale feature alignment, transposed-attention merging and resolution-transfer upsampling; specializes each module for alignment, aggregation and output reconstruction.

name: KBNet
official_title: Kernel-Aware Burst Blind Super-Resolution
classification_basis: To handle unknown burst blur, estimates kernel-related priors and conditions pyramid deformable alignment on them; integrates degradation awareness into RAW-frame fusion for blind super-resolution.

name: Raw/sRGB HDR Video
official_title: HDR Video Reconstruction with a Large Dynamic Dataset in Raw and sRGB Domains
classification_basis: To obtain real dynamic HDR supervision, captures simultaneous staggered exposures for 85 scenes and builds RAW/sRGB targets; Raw-HDRNet uses pyramid flow-guided deformable convolution to align neighboring RAW frames.

name: RawHDR
official_title: RawHDR: High Dynamic Range Image Reconstruction from a Single Raw Image
classification_basis: To recover HDR from a single RAW, learns hard/easy exposure masks and combines informative-channel intensity guidance with global spatial guidance; contributes paired RAW/HDR data for highlights and shadow reconstruction.

name: Self-Supervised Burst SR
official_title: Self-Supervised Burst Super-Resolution
classification_basis: To train without high-resolution references, uses a learned forward imaging model to supervise reconstruction from only noisy low-resolution bursts; exploits aliased high frequencies and accommodates dynamic motion in real captures.

name: Single-Shot HDR Demosaic
official_title: Joint Demosaicing and Deghosting of Time-Varying Exposures for Single-Shot HDR Imaging
classification_basis: To combine time-varying Quad-Bayer exposures without ghosting, extracts mosaicked exposure features and registers spatial/color displacements with a multiscale Transformer; contributes matching sensor-pattern data for joint HDR demosaicing.

name: 2StageAlign
official_title: A Differentiable Two-stage Alignment Scheme for Burst Image Reconstruction with Large Shift
classification_basis: To handle large burst shifts efficiently, first performs differentiable progressive block matching at patch level, then refines alignment implicitly in full-resolution features; supports joint burst denoising and demosaicing.

name: BIPNet
official_title: Burst Image Restoration and Enhancement
classification_basis: To fuse complementary burst details while rejecting degradation, aligns features with an edge-boosting module and constructs pseudo-burst representations; adaptive aggregation progressively merges these features and increases resolution.

name: BSRT
official_title: BSRT: Improving Burst Super-Resolution with Swin Transformer and Flow-Guided Deformable Alignment
classification_basis: To recover burst detail under motion, combines a Swin Transformer backbone with pyramid flow-guided deformable alignment; models long-range structure while merging complementary textures from accurately aligned RAW frames.

name: HDR+SR Bursts
official_title: High Dynamic Range and Super-Resolution from Raw Image Bursts
classification_basis: To reconstruct HDR and resolution together, jointly processes exposure-bracketed handheld RAW bursts rather than cascading separate merging and upscaling stages; exploits spatial and exposure diversity for a high-resolution HDR color output.

name: DBSR
official_title: Deep Burst Super-Resolution
classification_basis: To learn multiframe RAW zoom, aligns noisy frames with optical flow and fuses them with attention before denoised RGB upsampling; contributes BurstSR smartphone bursts paired with DSLR high-resolution references.

name: Deep-Rep
official_title: Deep Reparametrization of Multi-Frame Super-Resolution and Denoising
classification_basis: To combine physical fusion and learned priors, reparameterizes a multi-frame MAP objective using learned error metrics and latent image features; applies the same latent-space optimization to burst denoising and super-resolution.

name: EBSR
official_title: EBSR: Feature Enhanced Burst Super-Resolution with Deformable Alignment
classification_basis: To align and reconstruct burst textures, combines feature-enhanced pyramid deformable alignment, cross-nonlocal fusion and long-range concatenation reconstruction; cascading residual paths improve information flow across stages.

name: GCP-Net
official_title: Joint Denoising and Demosaicking with Green Channel Prior for Real-world Burst Images
classification_basis: To preserve structure in noisy real bursts, uses Bayer's denser and cleaner green channel as a prior for joint denoising/demosaicing; guides missing-color recovery with this more reliable sampled information.

name: Lucas-Kanade Reloaded
official_title: Lucas-Kanade Reloaded: End-to-End Super-Resolution from Raw Image Bursts
classification_basis: To align bursts with subpixel precision while retaining physical interpretation, embeds learnable Lucas–Kanade registration and an image prior in an end-to-end RAW reconstruction algorithm; exploits aliasing as super-resolution information.

name: Merging-ISP
official_title: Merging-ISP: Multi-Exposure High Dynamic Range Image Signal Processing
classification_basis: To avoid error propagation through independent HDR and ISP stages, jointly learns multi-exposure merging, demosaicing and rendering in one neural pipeline; maps RAW measurements directly to the final HDR image.

name: Tri-Exposure Quad-Bayer HDR
official_title: HDR Video Reconstruction with Tri-Exposure Quad-Bayer Sensors
classification_basis: To recover moving HDR scenes from interleaved exposures, divides reconstruction subtasks in a tri-exposure Quad-Bayer network and uses an LDR-reconstruction loss balancing highlights/shadows; reduces brightness-range imbalance during training.

name: BPN
official_title: Basis Prediction Networks for Effective Burst Denoising with Large Kernels
classification_basis: To use large burst-denoising kernels efficiently, predicts a shared set of global basis kernels and pixel-specific mixing coefficients; low-dimensional kernel factorization exploits spatiotemporal self-similarity without dense per-pixel kernel tensors.

name: Decoupled Burst Denoising
official_title: A Decoupled Learning Scheme for Real-world Burst Denoising from Raw Images
classification_basis: To avoid entangling motion estimation with sensor noise, designs a multiframe CNN that learns motion and noise statistics separately; evaluates the decoupled fusion scheme on synthetic and real dynamic RAW sequences.

name: Deep Snapshot HDR
official_title: Deep Snapshot HDR Imaging Using Multi-Exposure Color Filter Array
classification_basis: To reconstruct HDR from a multi-exposure CFA, jointly learns missing colors and exposure fusion with luminance-normalized inputs/losses; balances errors in bright and dark regions regardless of absolute radiance.

name: TSWT Burst
official_title: Burst Denoising via Temporally Shifted Wavelet Transforms
classification_basis: To support variable-length burst denoising cheaply, shifts wavelet-derived temporal features; high-frequency bands preserve local detail while low-frequency bands carry structure, trained with realistic sensor noise for deployment.

name: Iterative Residual Burst
official_title: Iterative Residual CNNs for Burst Photography Applications
classification_basis: To retain a physical model in learned burst processing, unfolds proximal-gradient-style optimization into an iterative residual CNN; handles denoising/demosaicing with no inherent restriction on burst length or frame order.

name: Night Sight
official_title: Handheld Mobile Photography in Very Low Light
classification_basis: To capture handheld low-light scenes sharply, motion metering selects exposure/count, noise-aware alignment merges frames and learned white balance restores color; specialized tone mapping preserves the visual appearance of nighttime.

name: Deep Burst Denoising
official_title: Deep Burst Denoising
classification_basis: To fuse an arbitrary number of noisy frames, adds recurrent fully convolutional integration to a single-frame denoiser; incrementally reuses past observations and evaluates the design for denoising and super-resolution.

name: KPN
official_title: Burst Denoising with Kernel Prediction Networks
classification_basis: To align and denoise handheld bursts jointly, predicts spatially varying spatiotemporal kernels from noisy frames and noise levels; realistic noise simulation and annealed training losses help avoid poor local minima.

name: Neural Block-wise Auto-exposure
official_title: Neural Block-wise Auto-exposure for Single-Shot High Dynamic Range Imaging
classification_basis: To adapt single-shot HDR capture to local brightness, predicts exposure for every nonoverlapping 16×16 sensor block from a preview image and its exposure time; compares RAW- and sRGB-preview conditioning.

name: BinRVR
official_title: Binarized High-Efficiency RAW Video Restoration and Beyond
classification_basis: To reduce RAW-video restoration cost, models spatial/temporal information with a binarized interaction module and uses activation-distribution-aware binary convolution to limit quantization error; supports multibit trade-offs and several restoration tasks.

name: RawHDRV
official_title: High Dynamic Range Video Reconstruction from Single-Exposure Raw Sequences
classification_basis: To recover HDR from single-exposure RAW sequences, aligns Bayer channels separately, weights fusion by exposure and restores saturation using an exposure-complementarity mask; contributes mobile RAW video with per-frame HDR references.

name: Real-Time Raw2Raw Mobile Denoise
official_title: Efficient Real-Time Raw-to-Raw Denoising for Extreme Low-Light Ultra HD Video on Mobile Devices
classification_basis: To integrate UHD low-light denoising into commercial ISPs, combines a sensor-diverse data protocol, mobile-specific low-complexity architecture and post-training reparameterization, restructuring and quantization; evaluates latency and power constraints for real-time RAW-to-RAW video.

name: DarkVRAI
official_title: DarkVRAI: Capture-Condition Conditioning and Burst-Order Selective Scan for Low-light RAW Video Denoising
classification_basis: To align and denoise noisy low-light video, conditions processing on capture metadata and introduces burst-order selective scanning for long-range temporal dependencies; combines capture-aware guidance with sequence modeling in one RAW-video framework.

name: RViDeformer
official_title: RViDeformer: Efficient Raw Video Denoising Transformer with a Larger Benchmark Dataset
classification_basis: To learn realistic motion-aware denoising efficiently, introduces screen-recaptured ReCRVD data and a Transformer with multibranch spatial/temporal attention across local, downsampled global and neighboring windows; reparameterization reduces inference cost.

name: Alignment-free Raw Video Demoire
official_title: Alignment-free Raw Video Demoireing
classification_basis: To avoid costly explicit motion alignment, DemMamba combines frequency-assisted spatial processing with temporal Mamba; bidirectional temporal scans and channel attention fuse frames while maintaining consistency during RAW-video demoiréing.

name: BRVE
official_title: Binarized Low-light Raw Video Enhancement
classification_basis: To make low-light video enhancement compatible with binary networks, uses spatial/temporal shifts for cheap alignment and fusion, plus distribution-aware binary convolution to compensate for information lost during quantization.

name: Pre/Post-Demosaic Video Denoise
official_title: Combining Pre- and Post-Demosaicking Noise Removal for RAW Video
classification_basis: To adapt denoising to varying noise levels, weights self-similarity denoisers before and after demosaicing and adds temporal-trajectory prefiltering; stronger sensor noise receives more pre-demosaic processing for improved texture recovery.

name: VJDD
official_title: Toward Accurate and Temporally Consistent Video Restoration from Raw Data
classification_basis: To preserve texture without temporal flicker, jointly denoises/demosaics RAW video through latent-state propagation; data-temporal and relational-perceptual consistency losses reduce reliance on error-prone optical-flow supervision.

name: FloRNN
official_title: Unidirectional Video Denoising by Mimicking Backward Recurrent Modules with Look-ahead Forward Ones
classification_basis: To approximate bidirectional context at bounded latency, combines forward recurrence with a look-ahead forward module using near-future frames; forward warping and border enlargement compensate for motion-related missing pixels.

name: Real-RawVSR
official_title: Real-RawVSR: Real-World Raw Video Super-Resolution with a Benchmark Dataset
classification_basis: To benchmark real RAW-video super-resolution, captures 450 synchronized low/high-resolution pairs with a beam splitter; a dual-branch network co-aligns and fuses packed RGGB and original Bayer sequences to reconstruct high-resolution sRGB.

name: Starlight Denoising
official_title: Dancing under the Stars: Video Denoising in Starlight
classification_basis: To denoise video below 0.001 lux, tunes a physical camera-noise model with a GAN and trains on simulated video plus real noisy stills; contributes moving starlight captures for extreme-noise evaluation.

name: EMVD
official_title: Efficient Multi-Stage Video Denoising with Recurrent Spatio-Temporal Fusion
classification_basis: To enable mobile RAW-video denoising, recursively fuses past frames, denoises the fused representation and refines high frequencies; all stages use learned invertible linear transforms to reduce complexity while supporting end-to-end training.

name: RViDeNet
official_title: Supervised Raw Video Denoising with a Benchmark Dataset on Dynamic Scenes
classification_basis: To obtain dynamic-scene clean/noisy supervision, records controllable motion as repeated static moments for CRVD; separately denoises packed Bayer subsequences using temporal/spatial/channel correlations, then fuses RAW and optionally renders sRGB.

name: High-Sensitivity Noise Video
official_title: Enhancing Low Light Videos by Exploring High Sensitivity Camera Noise
