classification_basis: To model noise neglected at high sensor gain, derives a physical high-sensitivity noise model and synthesizes dark/bright training videos; an LSTM-based network learns temporally informed denoising and brightness restoration.

name: Adaptive Color Grading
official_title: Adaptive Color Grading
classification_basis: To control shadows/highlights independently, predicts tonescale-region thresholds with K-nearest neighbors trained on annotated video frames; region-specific CIELAB adjustments compose into one deployable 3D LUT within an open grading tool.

name: PrefLUT
official_title: PrefLUT: Reusable and Refinable Personalized Color Editing from Pairwise Preferences
classification_basis: To retain preferences beyond a single reference, encodes preferred/nonpreferred pairs into a reusable, refinable profile conditioning LUT and strength prediction; introduces controlled preference-verification tests without per-user optimization.

name: LoopLUT
official_title: LoopLUT: 3D Lookup Tables with Progressive Region Refinement for Real-Time 4K Image Enhancement
classification_basis: To add local adaptivity to fast LUT enhancement, cascades a global LUT with region-conditioned residual LUTs; low-resolution gates partition the image so high-resolution rendering needs only a small fixed number of lookups.

name: FlowTool
official_title: FlowTool: Controlling Tool Parameter in Image Retouching via Flow Matching
classification_basis: To predict editable tool settings from images and instructions, models their joint distribution with conditional rectified flow using a vision-language backbone and diffusion Transformer; staged flow training plus reward post-training replaces sequential parameter reasoning.

name: Synthetic Dense Illuminant
official_title: A General Pipeline for Dense Illuminant Estimation via Physically Based Synthetic Data
classification_basis: To obtain dense illumination truth cheaply, derives per-pixel illuminant chromaticity from physically rendered 3D scenes; generates 74,321 controlled-light images for pretraining single- and multi-illuminant estimators.

name: C2LUT
official_title: Illuminant-Adaptive 3D Lookup Tables for Camera Color Correction
classification_basis: To correct color across spectrally diverse illuminants, conditions nonlinear 3D LUTs on chromaticity-aware illumination features and compresses them with Tucker decomposition; contributes 1,473 illuminant spectra for evaluation.

name: Multispectral CC
official_title: Leveraging Multispectral Sensors for Color Correction in Mobile Cameras
classification_basis: To resolve color ambiguity in RGB sensing, jointly processes high-resolution RGB and auxiliary low-resolution multispectral data in an end-to-end correction model; constructs training/evaluation data from spectral datasets and varied camera sensitivities.

name: RL-AWB
official_title: RL-AWB: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Auto White Balance Correction in Low-Light Night-time Scenes
classification_basis: To tune white balance in noisy nighttime scenes, starts from salient-gray-pixel statistics and learns an RL policy for image-specific parameters without reference illuminants; contributes a multisensor night dataset.

name: SAFE
official_title: SAFE: Scene-Aware Feature Modulation for Color Constancy with Learned Color Space in Pure-Color Scenes
classification_basis: To avoid chromaticity collapse in near-uniform-color scenes, combines a four-token scene-aware illumination representation with learned scene-dependent color-space normalization; reweights cues according to scene complexity.

name: VLM-CC
official_title: White-Balance First, Adjust Later: Cross-Camera Color Constancy via Vision-Language Evaluation
classification_basis: To refine white balance across cameras, applies a coarse correction then iterates using vision-language perceptual evaluation; lightweight VLM adaptation supplies feedback instead of directly regressing illuminant RGB.

name: WB Color Space
official_title: Perception-Inspired Color Space Design for Photo White Balance Editing
classification_basis: To separate brightness from color during white-balance editing, learns a perception-inspired HSI space with adjustable chromatic mapping and a matching Mamba network; improves correction through representation rather than fixed color coordinates.

name: ABC-Former
official_title: ABC-Former: Auxiliary Bimodal Cross-domain Transformer with Interactive Channel Attention for White Balance
classification_basis: To preserve global color trends in white balancing, fuses sRGB with CIELab and RGB-histogram information using a bimodal cross-domain Transformer; interactive channel attention transfers complementary global cues.

name: Camera-Agnostic WB Pref.
official_title: Learning Camera-Agnostic White-Balance Preferences
classification_basis: To produce consistent aesthetic white balance across cameras, learns a compact post-estimation mapping from neutral correction to preferred correction in a camera-independent space; attaches after existing AWB modules without retraining unseen sensors.

name: CCMNet
official_title: CCMNet: Leveraging Calibrated Color Correction Matrices for Cross-Camera Color Constancy
classification_basis: To estimate illumination for unseen cameras, uses calibrated CCMs to project canonical illuminant colors into sensor space; camera/CCM interpolation augmentation reduces overfitting and enables cross-camera estimation without retraining.

name: GCC
official_title: GCC: Generative Color Constancy via Diffusing a Color Checker
classification_basis: To exploit generative scene priors for illumination, deterministically inpaints a color checker with diffusion and reads its color; Laplacian decomposition preserves checker structure and mask augmentation handles annotation uncertainty.

name: IFFCC
official_title: Integral Fast Fourier Color Constancy
classification_basis: To extend Fourier color constancy to mixed lighting, computes integral UV histograms for arbitrary regions and parallel Fourier convolutions; estimates a spatially smooth illuminant map efficiently.

name: Revisiting MIWB
official_title: Revisiting Image Fusion for Multi-Illuminant White-Balance Correction
classification_basis: To improve multi-illuminant correction beyond linear preset blending, uses a compact Transformer modeling spatial dependencies across five WB renditions; contributes over 16,000 multilight images with corrected references.

name: Time-Aware AWB
official_title: Time-Aware Auto White Balance in Mobile Photography
classification_basis: To estimate light with a small mobile model, combines image colors, time, location and capture metadata in an approximately 5K-parameter network; contributes 3,224 contextual-metadata smartphone captures.

name: AID
official_title: Attentive Illumination Decomposition Model for Multi-Illuminant White Balancing
classification_basis: To separate multiple illuminants, assigns slot-attention representations to individual lights and predicts their chromaticities/weight maps; centroid-matching loss regularizes slot activation before spatial illumination fusion.

name: Dual-Exposure Illuminant
official_title: Optimizing Illuminant Estimation in Dual-Exposure HDR Imaging
classification_basis: To use exposure complementarity for white balance, extracts a dual-exposure feature and integrates it into an MLP and convolutional color-constancy estimator; improves illumination inference from existing HDR captures.

name: NightCC
official_title: NightCC: Nighttime Color Constancy via Adaptive Channel Masking
classification_basis: To adapt daylight supervision to unlabeled night scenes, combines adaptive channel masking and pixelwise light-uncertainty estimates; suppresses unreliable pseudo labels in multi-illuminant color-constancy training.

name: NILUT
official_title: NILUT: Conditional Neural Implicit 3D Lookup Tables for Image Enhancement
classification_basis: To store multiple color styles compactly, represents a continuous 3D color transform with a small neural implicit function; conditioning shares one model across LUT styles and enables continuous blending.

name: WB LUTs
official_title: WB LUTs: Contrastive Learning for White Balancing Lookup Tables
classification_basis: To perform high-resolution white balance in real time, learns 3D LUT correction with contrastive training and hard-sample mining; strengthens the compact LUT predictor without dense full-resolution network inference.

name: DeNIM
official_title: Deterministic Neural Illumination Mapping for Efficient Auto-White Balance Correction
classification_basis: To make white-balance correction resolution-independent, learns projection matrices for canonical-illumination and corrected-output mappings; accepts pretrained AWB backbones while applying efficient deterministic color transformation.

name: LLF-LUT
official_title: Lookup Table meets Local Laplacian Filter: Pyramid Reconstruction Network for Tone Mapping
classification_basis: To tone-map HDR efficiently while retaining local edges, predicts pixelwise basis-LUT weights with a low-resolution Transformer and refines high-frequency pyramid bands using a learned local Laplacian filter; avoids costly high-resolution convolutions.

name: Style-AWB
official_title: Modeling the Lighting in Scenes as Style for Auto White-Balance Correction
classification_basis: To correct mixed lighting without explicit illuminant estimation, extracts lighting style with multiple heads and predicts spatial blend weights over preset-WB renderings; supports both single- and multi-illuminant scenes.

name: AdaInt
official_title: AdaInt: Learning Adaptive Intervals for 3D Lookup Tables on Real-time Image Enhancement
classification_basis: To allocate LUT samples where colors need them, learns nonuniform intervals in 3D color space with a differentiable adaptive-interval transform; adds content-adaptive sampling to existing real-time LUT enhancers.

name: Enriched Illuminants
official_title: Learning Enriched Illuminants for Cross and Single Sensor Color Constancy
classification_basis: To diversify color-constancy supervision across sensors, relights white-balanced RAW/sRGB with sensor-independent sampled illuminants; a shared-backbone cascaded model with stage-specific attention improves compact cross-camera learning.

name: MIMT
official_title: MIMT: Multi-Illuminant Color Constancy via Multi-Task Local Surface and Light Color Learning
classification_basis: To separate local surface color from multiple lights, adds achromatic-pixel detection and surface-similarity auxiliary tasks; a local feature-preservation constraint maintains surface consistency as illumination changes.

name: Mixed-Illuminant AWB
official_title: Auto White-Balance Correction for Mixed-Illuminant Scenes
classification_basis: To correct spatially mixed lighting without one global illuminant, renders several preset white balances and learns per-pixel blending maps; fuses these alternatives into a locally corrected output.

name: SepLUT
official_title: SepLUT: Separable Image-adaptive Lookup Tables for Real-time Image Enhancement
classification_basis: To reduce LUT size while retaining color interactions, factors enhancement into component-independent 1D LUTs followed by a component-correlated 3D LUT; learns image-dependent transforms in this separable cascade.

name: C5
official_title: Cross-Camera Convolutional Color Constancy
classification_basis: To estimate illumination on an unseen sensor, uses transductive inference with additional unlabeled images from that camera; calibrates learned color features to test-sensor spectral properties during prediction.

name: CLCC
official_title: CLCC: Contrastive Learning for Color Constancy
classification_basis: To learn illuminant-dependent rather than appearance-dependent features, constructs contrastive pairs with RAW color augmentation; improves robustness where training illuminants are sparse using a compact estimator.

name: INTEL-TAU
official_title: INTEL-TAU: A Color Constancy Dataset
classification_basis: To evaluate camera/scene generalization, releases 7,022 high-resolution images from three camera models with illuminant references; provides corrected/uncorrected mobile color-shading variants and benchmarks existing estimators.

name: LSMI
official_title: Large Scale Multi-Illuminant (LSMI) Dataset for Developing White Balance Algorithm under Mixed Illumination
classification_basis: To provide real mixed-light supervision, captures 7,486 images across cameras/scenes and derives illumination truth from different light combinations; benchmarks per-pixel neural white balance against patchwise processing.

name: Multi-color Balance
official_title: Multi-color balance for color constancy
classification_basis: To correct more than the neutral axis, computes an n-color transform from multiple target/reference color correspondences; adjusts those anchors exactly while extending correction to remaining colors.

name: Two-Camera AWB
official_title: Leveraging the Availability of Two Cameras for Illuminant Estimation
classification_basis: To resolve illumination using spectral diversity, feeds measurements from two different camera sensors into a small neural estimator; contributes dual-camera data and compares against heavier single-image methods.

name: 3D-LUT
official_title: Learning Image-adaptive 3D Lookup Tables for High Performance Photo Enhancement in Real-time
classification_basis: To enhance high-resolution photos cheaply, jointly learns basis 3D LUTs and a small CNN predicting image-dependent fusion weights; applies the fused transform by lookup rather than dense per-pixel neural processing.

name: Bag of Color Features
official_title: Bag of Color Features For Color Constancy
classification_basis: To estimate illumination with few parameters, pools local color features into a bag representation and reweights them with self-attention; generalizes statistical color-constancy cues without requiring global spatial layout.

name: C4
official_title: Cascading Convolutional Color Constancy
classification_basis: To stabilize illuminant regression across scenes/cameras, cascades dependent convolutional hypotheses with a weighted multiply-accumulate loss; explicitly trains coarse-to-fine corrections rather than one-shot regression.

name: CSRNet
official_title: Conditional Sequential Modulation for Efficient Global Image Retouching
classification_basis: To reproduce pixel-independent retouching efficiently, uses a per-pixel MLP modulated by global condition features; learns global color/tone operations with a compact base network and condition network.

name: CURL
official_title: CURL: Neural Curve Layers for Global Image Enhancement
classification_basis: To make learned enhancement interpretable, predicts adjustment curves jointly in RGB, HSV and CIELab with a multicolor-space loss; combines these global neural curve layers with a local multiscale backbone.

name: Deep WB Editing
official_title: Deep White-Balance Editing
classification_basis: To edit white balance after camera rendering, predicts indoor/outdoor WB alternatives with an end-to-end network and maps them to full resolution; permits correction and user-selected intermediate color temperatures in sRGB.

name: DeepLPF
official_title: DeepLPF: Deep Local Parametric Filters for Image Enhancement
classification_basis: To learn spatially local photo adjustments, regresses elliptical, graduated and polynomial filter parameters; applies these interpretable filters selectively instead of relying only on global transforms or unrestricted pixel synthesis.

name: Few-Shot CC (Multi-Domain)
official_title: Multi-Domain Learning for Accurate and Few-Shot Color Constancy
classification_basis: To adapt color constancy with few target-camera examples, shares the feature extractor and illuminant estimator across devices while learning camera-specific channel reweighting; updates only those small adaptation parameters for unseen cameras.

name: Interactive WB
official_title: Interactive White Balancing for Camera-Rendered Images
classification_basis: To support postcapture user control, links nonlinear WB color mappings to selected reference colors; extends automatic correction to interactive adjustment of camera-rendered images without access to RAW.

name: Metric-Learning Illuminant
official_title: End-to-End Illuminant Estimation Based on Deep Metric Learning
classification_basis: To make illuminant features less sensitive to scene appearance, trains an illuminant-guided triplet network jointly with regression; groups lighting-consistent samples without a separate illuminant-classification stage.

name: Multi-Hypothesis CC
official_title: A Multi-Hypothesis Approach to Color Constancy
classification_basis: To handle illumination ambiguity across cameras, corrects an image with candidate illuminants, scores achromatic likelihood using a camera-agnostic CNN and learns the final estimate from the resulting posterior.

name: Temporal CC Benchmark
official_title: A Benchmark for Temporal Color Constancy
classification_basis: To evaluate multi-frame illumination estimation consistently, releases 600 real mobile viewfinder sequences with a fixed split and a temporal baseline; compares over twenty methods under a shared protocol.

name: Convolutional Mean
official_title: Convolutional Mean: A Simple Convolutional Neural Network for Illuminant Estimation
classification_basis: To estimate illuminants at low latency, uses a roughly 1.1K-parameter CNN operating on 48×32 thumbnails; demonstrates the accuracy/compute trade-off without high-resolution or deep backbone processing.

name: Patch-wise Bright Pixels CC
official_title: Fast Color Constancy with Patch-wise Bright Pixels
classification_basis: To obtain fast training-free illumination estimates, downsamples into patches and selects a brightness-dependent fraction of bright pixels per patch; applies gray-world statistics only to these selected observations.

name: Quasi-Unsupervised CC
official_title: Quasi-Unsupervised Color Constancy
classification_basis: To avoid illuminant labels, trains a CNN to detect achromatic pixels from grayscale versions of approximately balanced web images; estimates light from selected pixels and allows later supervised fine-tuning.

name: Separate Illuminants
official_title: Learning to Separate Multiple Illuminants in a Single Image
classification_basis: To separate a two-light scene from one image, predicts pixelwise reflectance chromaticity with a physics-informed network/loss; combines it with an illumination-separation formulation to recover each light's scene appearance.

name: SIIE
official_title: Sensor-Independent Illumination Estimation for DNN Models
classification_basis: To avoid retraining for every sensor, learns a sensor-independent working space that preserves RAW linearity; canonicalizes unseen-camera colors before applying a shared neural illuminant estimator.

name: WB Augmenter
official_title: What Else Can Fool Deep Learning? Addressing Color Constancy Errors on Deep Neural Network Performance
classification_basis: To improve recognition under white-balance errors, synthesizes realistic color-constancy degradations rather than generic color jitter; compares augmentation and correction preprocessing for classification/segmentation robustness.

name: WB_sRGB
official_title: When Color Constancy Goes Wrong: Correcting Improperly White-Balanced Images
classification_basis: To correct WB after nonlinear camera processing, retrieves neighbors from over 65,000 wrong/correct image pairs and fits a nonlinear color mapping; transfers correction to cameras outside the training set.

name: Exposure
official_title: Exposure: A White-Box Photo Post-Processing Framework
classification_basis: To learn a preferred editing style without paired retouches, trains an RL agent to choose interpretable filters and settings with an adversarial objective; reproduces the style distribution of a reference photo collection.

name: Meta-Learning CC
official_title: Formulating Camera-Adaptive Color Constancy as a Few-shot Meta-Learning Problem
classification_basis: To adapt quickly to unseen cameras, organizes illuminant regression into physically meaningful color-temperature tasks and meta-learns across cameras; fine-tunes with only a handful of target-device examples.

name: Semantic WB
official_title: Semantic White Balance: Semantic Color Constancy Using Convolutional Neural Network
classification_basis: To use object semantics as illumination cues, feeds segmentation-derived semantic information alongside color/spatial features to a CNN; jointly estimates illuminant color and gamma parameters.

name: FC4
official_title: FC4: Fully Convolutional Color Constancy with Confidence-weighted Pooling
classification_basis: To weight informative image regions rather than averaging all patches, predicts local illuminants and confidence with a fully convolutional network; confidence-weighted pooling yields one end-to-end global estimate.

name: FFCC
official_title: Fast Fourier Color Constancy
classification_basis: To estimate light quickly with uncertainty, solves localization on a periodic log-chroma histogram in Fourier space; predicts an illuminant posterior that also supports temporal smoothing and calibrated training.

name: HDRNet
official_title: Deep Bilateral Learning for Real-Time Image Enhancement
classification_basis: To approximate complex photographic operators on phones, predicts local affine coefficients in a low-resolution bilateral grid and slices them at full resolution; learns content-adaptive transforms from example edits.

name: Recurrent CC
official_title: Recurrent Color Constancy
classification_basis: To use viewfinder history for illumination, combines convolutional LSTMs with simulated sequences in RCC-Net; jointly learns spatial/temporal cues and evaluates against single-frame and temporal baselines.

name: Unsupervised CC
official_title: Unsupervised Learning for Color Constancy
classification_basis: To avoid calibrated illumination labels, first approximates unknown training illuminants and learns estimator parameters from them; extends the formulation to transfer parameters between sensors using uncalibrated images.

name: Structured-Output CC
official_title: Deep Structured-Output Regression Learning for Computational Color Constancy
classification_basis: To model correlated illuminant outputs, combines CNN feature learning with structured multi-output regression; learns dependencies between color dimensions rather than treating them as independent prediction targets.

name: CCC
official_title: Convolutional Color Constancy
classification_basis: To learn which color casts are plausible, treats illuminant estimation as 2D log-chroma localization and learns a discriminative convolutional model; scores correct versus incorrect white-balance hypotheses.

name: Chroma from Luminance CC
official_title: Color Constancy by Learning to Predict Chromaticity from Luminance
classification_basis: To estimate illumination without spatial/semantic context, learns natural-image chromaticity likelihoods conditioned on pixel luminance; end-to-end optimization adjusts these statistics to minimize scene-level illuminant errors.

name: CNN CC (Bianco)
official_title: Color Constancy Using CNNs
classification_basis: To replace handcrafted illuminant features, trains a shallow patch CNN with convolution, max pooling and regression outputs; jointly learns spatial color features and illumination prediction, including preliminary local-light estimation.

name: Edit-aware RAW
official_title: Edit-aware RAW Reconstruction
classification_basis: To preserve editability rather than only default-render accuracy, trains with a modular differentiable ISP whose parameters are randomly sampled; the edit-aware loss penalizes reconstruction after varied realistic photographic adjustments.

name: MambaRaw
official_title: MambaRaw: Selective State Space Modeling for Efficient 4K Raw Image Reconstruction
classification_basis: To reconstruct 4K RAW from JPEG plus compact metadata efficiently, uses selective state-space scans on information-dense tiles and energy-aware residual refinement; models entropy with spatial/energy-coupled context.

name: MERIT
official_title: MERIT: Multi-domain Efficient RAW Image Translation
classification_basis: To avoid pairwise camera-specific translators, conditions a shared multi-domain RAW generator with multiscale large-kernel attention and a sensor-noise alignment loss; contributes five-sensor paired/unpaired MDRAW data.

name: RAW-Flow
official_title: RAW-Flow: Advancing RGB-to-RAW Image Reconstruction with Deterministic Latent Flow Matching
classification_basis: To address ambiguous RGB-to-RAW inversion, learns deterministic latent flow matching guided by cross-scale RGB context; a dual-domain autoencoder and feature alignment stabilize transport between RGB and RAW representations.

name: Raw-JPEG Adapter
official_title: Raw-JPEG Adapter: Efficient Raw Image Compression with JPEG
classification_basis: To store linear RAW using standard JPEG, learns compact invertible spatial and optional frequency transforms and stores parameters in the JPEG comment field; reconstructs RAW with improved rate–fidelity trade-offs.

name: RawGen
official_title: RawGen: Learning Camera Raw Image Generation
classification_basis: To generate camera-specific linear data with pretrained image priors, adapts diffusion in latent/pixel spaces for text-to-RAW and sRGB inversion; many-to-one inverse-ISP training anchors diverse renderings to the same scene-referred target.

name: RAWIC
official_title: RAWIC: Bit-Depth Adaptive Lossless Raw Image Compression
classification_basis: To losslessly compress varying-bit-depth RAW, packs Bayer into RGGB patches and conditions a learned entropy model on each patch's bit depth; adapts probability estimates to local signal ranges.

name: SpiralDiff
official_title: SpiralDiff: Spiral Diffusion with LoRA for RGB-to-RAW Conversion Across Cameras
classification_basis: To handle intensity-dependent inversion difficulty and multiple cameras, uses signal-dependent diffusion weighting plus camera-aware LoRA; adapts a shared RGB-to-RAW model with lightweight sensor-specific parameters.

name: Illum–Sensor Mapping
official_title: Improved Mapping Between Illuminations and Sensors for RAW Images
classification_basis: To map RAW across sensor spectra and illuminants, studies calibrated captures from 390 illuminations, four cameras and 18 scenes; improves illumination/sensor transfer and tests synthetic data for neural-ISP training.

name: Physically-Informed Raw2Raw
official_title: Beyond Calibration: Physically Informed Learning for Raw-to-Raw Mapping
classification_basis: To maintain color across cameras and lighting, a lightweight Neural Physical Model simulates RAW under specified illumination to estimate device transformations; supports physical initialization and paired or unpaired learning.

name: RAW-Diffusion
official_title: RAW-Diffusion: RGB-Guided Diffusion Models for High-Fidelity RAW Image Generation
classification_basis: To synthesize sensor-specific RAW from labeled RGB collections, injects multiresolution RGB-guidance features into reverse-diffusion residual blocks; generates BDD100K-RAW/Cityscapes-RAW for data-efficient RAW object detection.

name: ReRAW
official_title: ReRAW: RGB-to-RAW Image Reconstruction via Stratified Sampling for Efficient Object Detection on the Edge
classification_basis: To synthesize training RAW for edge detectors, predicts gamma-space RAW candidates with a multi-head network and selects training samples by intensity strata; improves bright-pixel recovery before detector pretraining.

name: Learnable CCM RAW Recon
official_title: A Learnable Color Correction Matrix for RAW Reconstruction
classification_basis: To synthesize RAW cheaply for driving perception, approximates inverse ISP with a learnable color-correction matrix implemented as one convolutional layer; evaluates simulated RAW for pretraining object detectors.

name: Prior Metadata RAW Recon
official_title: Prior Metadata-Driven RAW Reconstruction: Eliminating the Need for Per-Image Metadata
classification_basis: To avoid per-image metadata, searches compact offline RAW references for similar pixels and feeds retrieved priors to a neural reconstructor; compresses the reference pool to reduce search/storage cost.

name: Rawformer
official_title: Rawformer: Unpaired Raw-to-Raw Translation for Learnable Camera ISPs
classification_basis: To transfer an existing neural ISP to another sensor without paired captures, learns unpaired RAW-to-RAW translation using a Transformer encoder–decoder; maps new-camera measurements into the trained ISP's sensor domain.

name: SEL-CIE
official_title: SEL-CIE: Knowledge-Guided Self-Supervised Learning Framework for CIE-XYZ Reconstruction from Non-Linear sRGB Images
classification_basis: To reduce paired-data requirements for linear color reconstruction, combines knowledge-guided self-supervision with available paired sRGB/XYZ images; jointly reconstructs CIE XYZ and re-renders sRGB on the sRGB2XYZ benchmark.

name: sRGB-to-RAW Video
official_title: Leveraging Frame Affinity for sRGB-to-RAW Video De-rendering
classification_basis: To recover RAW consistently from video, extracts a temporal-affinity prior using motion and learns scene-/position-specific spatial mappings from prior frames; contributes a RAW-video de-rendering benchmark.

name: Unsupervised Raw2Raw ISP
official_title: Generalizing ISP Model by Unsupervised Raw-to-raw Mapping
classification_basis: To transfer an ISP without paired camera captures, predicts patchwise color-space transformation parameters with CSTPP and trains in a CycleGAN-style framework; maps sensor domains while handling spatially varying lighting.

name: Beyond R2LCM
official_title: Beyond Learned Metadata-based Raw Image Reconstruction
classification_basis: To improve JPEG-assisted RAW reconstruction, encodes compact latent metadata with asymmetric multiresolution features and a conditional context model; iterative coding masks enable variable bitrates within one model.

name: Graphics2RAW
official_title: Graphics2RAW: Mapping Computer Graphics Images to Sensor RAW Images
classification_basis: To turn graphics into sensor-matched training data, uses a few RAW-DNG examples to map each rendered scene to multiple cameras and illuminants; releases 292 realistic CG images for low-light training.

name: Metadata RAW (INF)
official_title: Metadata-Based RAW Reconstruction via Implicit Neural Functions
classification_basis: To reconstruct RAW from sparse embedded samples without camera pretraining, fits an implicit neural function mapping coordinates and corresponding sRGB values to RAW; learns each image self-supervised from its metadata.

name: R2LCM
official_title: Raw Image Reconstruction with Learned Compact Metadata
classification_basis: To reduce RAW storage while retaining a JPEG, learns compact latent metadata and an sRGB-guided entropy context model; adaptively allocates bits to informative regions for improved reconstruction per stored bit.

name: SRISP
official_title: Self-Supervised Reversed Image Signal Processing via Reference-Guided Dynamic Parameter Selection
classification_basis: To invert ISP without metadata or paired data, dynamically selects reversed-pipeline parameters from a reference RAW; generates RAW-like images matching the reference sensor/environment and tests their use in detection training.

name: Content-Aware Metadata
official_title: Learning sRGB-to-Raw-RGB De-rendering with Content-Aware Metadata
classification_basis: To spend reconstruction metadata where it matters, learns content-dependent sampling of original RAW values alongside a reconstruction network; online fine-tuning further adapts sRGB-to-RAW recovery to the stored samples.

name: MBISPLD
official_title: Model-Based Image Signal Processors via Learnable Dictionaries
classification_basis: To combine invertibility with interpretable ISP operations, learns rich parameter dictionaries inside a model-based bidirectional RAW/RGB pipeline; dictionary sampling supplies plausible augmentation even with few labeled captures.

name: Overexposure Mask Fusion
official_title: Overexposure Mask Fusion: Generalizable Reverse ISP Multi-Step Refinement
classification_basis: To recover RAW from clipped RGB more reliably, predicts demosaiced RAW rather than Bayer and applies overexposure-mask-guided multistep refinement; permits perceptual supervision and reuse with other reconstruction backbones.

name: Reverse Style Transfer ISP
official_title: Reversing Image Signal Processors by Reverse Style Transferring
classification_basis: To model ISP changes as removable style, RST-ISP-Net uses adaptive feature normalization in an end-to-end reverse-style-transfer architecture; investigates sRGB-to-RAW inversion in the AIM reversed-ISP setting.

name: CIE XYZ Net
official_title: CIE XYZ Net: Unprocessing Images for Low-Level Computer Vision Tasks
classification_basis: To avoid sensor-specific RAW targets, learns to unprocess nonlinear sRGB into canonical CIE XYZ; provides a scene-referred representation for low-level restoration and color-related vision tasks.

name: InvISP
official_title: Invertible Image Signal Processing
classification_basis: To retain RAW editability without a separate full RAW file, uses an invertible neural RAW/sRGB pipeline and differentiable JPEG simulation; trains rendering and reconstruction jointly under compression distortion.

name: Raw Bayer Synthesis for CV-ISP
official_title: Raw Bayer Pattern Image Synthesis for Computer Vision-oriented Image Signal Processing Pipeline Design
classification_basis: To reuse labeled color datasets for RAW perception, constrains GAN-based RGB-to-Bayer generation through an additional demosaicing transformation; supports arbitrary image sizes and evaluates end-to-end detector training on synthesized RAW.

name: Raw-to-Raw (Semi-Sup.)
official_title: Semi-Supervised Raw-to-Raw Mapping
classification_basis: To transfer sensor color spaces with few paired captures, jointly trains on a small paired subset and larger per-camera unpaired sets; contributes two-phone RAW data for semi-supervised mapping evaluation.

name: Spatially Aware Metadata
official_title: Spatially Aware Metadata for Raw Reconstruction
classification_basis: To invert spatially varying tone mapping, stores spatially distributed RAW samples with the processed image and uses them for reconstruction; requires only a small sample fraction with little capture-time computation.

name: CycleISP
official_title: CycleISP: Real Image Restoration via Improved Data Synthesis
classification_basis: To synthesize realistic denoising pairs, learns forward and reverse camera mappings and adds sensor noise between them; generates consistent RAW/sRGB noisy-clean data rather than assuming simple noise in rendered images.

name: Lossless Mosaic Compression
official_title: Lossless Compression of Mosaic Images with Convolutional Neural Network Prediction
classification_basis: To remove spatial/spectral redundancy without changing RAW values, predicts mosaic samples with a high-order nonlinear CNN and losslessly codes the residuals; specializes prediction for sensor color-pattern dependencies.

name: SingleHDR
official_title: Single-Image HDR Reconstruction by Learning to Reverse the Camera Pipeline
classification_basis: To recover information lost by LDR rendering, uses three specialized CNNs to reverse quantization, nonlinear camera response and clipping; joint fine-tuning limits errors across the physically structured HDR reconstruction stages.

name: Camera Pipeline Simulation
official_title: Generating Training Data for Denoising Real RGB Images via Camera Pipeline Simulation
classification_basis: To train JPEG denoisers with realistic noise, simulates RAW sensor noise and the subsequent camera pipeline; ablations identify the importance of realistic demosaicing and denoising during synthetic-data generation.

name: Unprocessing
official_title: Unprocessing Images for Learned Raw Denoising
classification_basis: To train RAW denoisers from ordinary photographs, reverses tone, color and gain processing, injects realistic sensor noise and evaluates losses through the forward ISP; makes training account for later photographic rendering.

name: Beyond Bayer
official_title: Beyond Bayer: Task-Optimal Sensor Co-Design for Robust Autonomous-Driving Segmentation
classification_basis: To optimize camera measurements for driving segmentation, differentiates a RAW-to-task pipeline through CFA and optics; controlled comparisons favor learned 2×2 CFA weights while retaining an identity PSF under the studied simulation.

name: FreqAdapt
official_title: FreqAdapt: Frequency-Adaptive Processing for RAW Object Detection
classification_basis: To adapt RAW for detection efficiently, jointly encodes Fourier amplitude, phase and spatial features to predict ISP parameters; learnable frequency-aware fusion enhances task-relevant detail before the detector.

name: RAWDet-7
official_title: RAWDet-7: A Multi-Scenario Benchmark for Object Detection and Description on Quantized RAW Images
classification_basis: To measure detection under RAW quantization, provides multicamera/multilight RAW data annotated for seven categories plus object descriptions derived from high-resolution sRGB; supports evaluation of information loss at reduced bit depth.

name: RAWild
official_title: RAWild: Sensor-Agnostic RAW Object Detection via Physics-Guided Curve and Grid Modeling
classification_basis: To generalize detection across sensors, combines global Bézier tone correction with local bilateral-grid color adjustment driven by RAW statistics; physics-based simulation varies spectra, illumination and sensor nonidealities during training.

name: RawVLA
official_title: RawVLA: Embodied Neural Image Signal Processor For Robotic Manipulation
classification_basis: To make imaging serve robotic action, trains a streaming neural ISP for frozen vision-language-action policies after analyzing gain, noise, color, tone and bit depth; contributes RawVLA-Bench under clean/adverse capture conditions.

name: SimROD
official_title: SimROD: A Simple Baseline for Raw Object Detection with Global and Local Enhancements
classification_basis: To adapt detectors to RAW cheaply, learns a four-parameter global gamma transform and green-channel-guided local enhancement; combines global dynamic-range adjustment with Bayer-aware detail cues.

name: Synthetic RAW Aug (Person Det)
official_title: Making the Discrete Continuous: Synthetic RAW Augmentations for Fine-Grained Evaluation of Person Detection Performance in Low Light
classification_basis: To evaluate pedestrian detection continuously across illumination, synthesizes RAW low-light augmentations matched to the sensor-noise model; fills sparse benchmark lighting levels and compares synthetic versus real performance trends.

name: TA-ISP
official_title: Task-Aware Image Signal Processor for Advanced Visual Perception
classification_basis: To avoid a heavy neural renderer or rigid parameter tuning, predicts multiscale modulation operators in a compact RAW-to-RGB adapter; optimizes representations for pretrained detection/segmentation models across day and night.

name: UniISP
official_title: UniISP: A Unified ISP Framework for Both Human and Machine Vision
classification_basis: To serve viewing and perception together, uses hybrid attention for visually supervised ISP rendering and a feature adapter that passes informative intermediate features to downstream networks; shares processing while preserving task cues.

name: AODRaw
official_title: Towards RAW Object Detection in Diverse Conditions
classification_basis: To evaluate RAW detection in diverse weather/light, contributes 7,785 images with 62 categories and studies direct RAW pretraining; distills sRGB-model knowledge to reduce the pretraining domain gap without extra preprocessing modules.

name: APP (Beyond RGB)
official_title: Beyond RGB: Adaptive Parallel Processing for RAW Object Detection
classification_basis: To replace viewing-oriented ISP for detection, learns adaptive parallel RAW-processing branches and fuses their outputs through a task-optimized Raw Adaptation Module; exposes complementary representations to the detector.

name: Bayer-Domain Video CV
official_title: Efficient Bayer-Domain Video Computer Vision with Fast Motion Estimation and Learned Perception Residual
classification_basis: To remove redundant video perception compute, feeds Bayer directly into task models and propagates features with fast parallel motion estimation; a learned perception residual corrects motion-induced feature errors.

name: Dark-ISP
official_title: Dark-ISP: Enhancing RAW Image Processing for Low-Light Object Detection
classification_basis: To align low-light rendering with detection, makes linear calibration and nonlinear tone stages differentiable and content-adaptive; physics-informed priors and a self-boost mechanism coordinate stages during task-driven training.

name: HDR Tone Mapping for Detection
official_title: Real-Time Scene-Adaptive Tone Mapping for High-Dynamic Range Object Detection
classification_basis: To feed HDR RAW into LDR-pretrained detectors, combines neural photometric calibration and scale-invariant local tone mapping; task-driven fine-tuning transfers detection while preserving details within real-time Jetson constraints.

name: RAW Keypoints
official_title: Keypoint Detection and Description for Raw Bayer Images
classification_basis: To avoid full ISP for robotic local features, designs two RAW convolution kernels preserving interchannel information; jointly learns Bayer keypoints/descriptors and evaluates robustness to rotation and scale changes.

name: RAW-Bench
official_title: RAW-Adapter: Adapting Pre-trained Visual Model to Camera RAW Images and A Benchmark
classification_basis: To test RAW-domain robustness, extends learnable ISP input adapters and model-level adaptation with 17 sensor-domain corruptions and RAW augmentation; evaluates pretrained visual models under imaging and environmental shifts.

name: SFA RAW Detection
official_title: Spatial-Frequency Aware for Object Detection in RAW Image
classification_basis: To expose frequency cues to detection without opaque spectral manipulation, inverse-transforms separate frequency bands into spatial maps; fuses these with spatial features for contour- and texture-aware RAW enhancement.

name: γ-Quant
official_title: γ-Quant: Towards Learnable Quantization for Low-bit Pattern Recognition
classification_basis: To retain recognition accuracy with low sensor bandwidth, learns task-specific nonlinear quantization rather than fixed uniform levels; demonstrates RAW detection using four-bit measurements against a twelve-bit reference.

name: AdaptiveISP
official_title: AdaptiveISP: Learning an Adaptive Image Signal Processor for Object Detection
classification_basis: To adapt processing structure and settings per scene, trains a reinforcement-learning policy to choose ISP modules and parameters using detection rewards; jointly optimizes the pipeline rather than a fixed viewing-quality objective.

name: ISP-Teacher
official_title: ISP-Teacher: Image Signal Process with Disentanglement Regularization for Unsupervised Domain Adaptive Dark Object Detection
classification_basis: To adapt daytime detection to unlabeled dark scenes, uses ISP-guided teacher–student learning with disentanglement regularization; couples imaging transformations and domain adaptation rather than requiring target detection labels.

name: RAW-Adapter
official_title: RAW-Adapter: Adapting Pre-trained Visual Model to Camera RAW Images
classification_basis: To reuse sRGB-pretrained detection/segmentation, learns ISP-based input adapters and intermediate model adapters for RAW; adjusts both the rendered input distribution and task-network features during adaptation.

name: ρ-Vision
official_title: Efficient Visual Computing with Camera RAW Snapshots
classification_basis: To train ISP-free vision despite scarce RAW data, CycleR2R learns unpaired modular RAW/RGB mappings with a CycleGAN objective; simulated RAW adapts existing detectors and compression models to sensor measurements.

name: DynamicISP
official_title: DynamicISP: Dynamically Controlled Image Signal Processor for Image Recognition
classification_basis: To keep task-aware processing light, controls classical ISP parameters for each frame using the previous frame's recognition result; gains adaptivity without replacing every stage with a large neural renderer.

name: Fully-Quantized Face Detector
official_title: Fully Quantized Always-on Face Detector Considering Mobile Image Sensors
classification_basis: To enable always-on sensing inside image sensors, uses sensor-aware synthetic RAW with a shallow face detector and ternary weights; evaluates low-bit processing before ISP under tight compute and bandwidth constraints.

name: ISP-less CV
official_title: Enabling ISP-less Low-Power Computer Vision
classification_basis: To train low-power vision without an ISP, inverts existing RGB datasets into RAW and combines direct RAW inference with analog in-pixel demosaicing; contributes RAW COCO and evaluates accuracy/energy/bandwidth trade-offs.

name: LIS
official_title: Instance Segmentation in the Dark
classification_basis: To suppress noise in low-light segmentation features, uses adaptive weighted downsampling, smooth-oriented convolution and disturbance-suppression learning; contributes synthetic RAW augmentation and over 2,000 annotated paired captures.

name: RAOD / ROD
official_title: Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Benchmark and A New Model
classification_basis: To exploit HDR sensor information for detection, introduces the ROD RAW benchmark and learns image-adaptive dynamic-range adjustment jointly with a detector; analyzes effects of texture and pixel distributions.

name: Raw Instinct
official_title: Raw Instinct: Trust Your Classifiers and Skip the Conversion
classification_basis: To test whether RGB conversion is necessary for classification, trains two CNNs on paired RAW/RGB captures and compares accuracy and total latency; contributes a dataset for direct sensor-domain recognition.

name: Raw or Cooked
official_title: Raw or Cooked? Object Detection on RAW Images
classification_basis: To align preprocessing with detection rather than viewing, jointly learns RAW-processing operations and detector weights; compares the learned pipeline against conventional RGB and earlier RAW methods on PASCALRAW.

name: Rawgment
official_title: Rawgment: Noise-Accounted RAW Augmentation Enables Recognition in a Wide Variety of Environments
classification_basis: To improve recognition under unseen capture conditions, augments in RAW with explicit noise accounting and aligns noise magnitude after augmentation; reduces the sensor-noise domain gap without collecting every environment.

name: Shadow Detection in RAW
official_title: Adaptive Illumination Mapping for Shadow Detection in Raw Images
classification_basis: To retain both local and global contrast, maps high-dynamic-range RAW into multiple illumination ranges with an adaptive module; shadow-aware feedback trains the mapping alongside detection using a 7,000-image RAW benchmark.

name: All You Need is RAW
official_title: All You Need is RAW: Defending Against Adversarial Attacks with Camera Image Pipelines
classification_basis: To remove adversarial patterns without attack-specific training, projects RGB into learned Bayer RAW and back through a camera pipeline; uses the RAW distribution as a model-agnostic preprocessing prior.

name: GenISP
official_title: GenISP: Neural ISP for Low-Light Machine Cognition
classification_basis: To generalize low-light detection across sensors, first transforms RAW into device-independent color, then predicts two stages of global color parameters; trains with a frozen detector and contributes annotated RAW-NOD data.

name: IA-YOLO
official_title: Image-Adaptive YOLO for Object Detection in Adverse Weather Conditions
classification_basis: To adapt detection to fog and darkness, a small CNN predicts differentiable image-filter parameters and trains jointly with YOLOv3; learns per-image enhancement from detection feedback instead of clean-image targets.

name: Log-Gradient Input
official_title: Improving the Energy Efficiency and Robustness of tinyML Computer Vision using Log-Gradient Input Images
classification_basis: To reduce tinyML input bandwidth and illumination sensitivity, feeds quantized log-gradient images to CNNs; evaluates aggressive first-layer quantization, pruning potential and recognition stability across exposure changes.

name: Dirty Pixels
official_title: Dirty Pixels: Towards End-to-End Image Processing and Perception
classification_basis: To optimize imaging for recognition, jointly trains differentiable demosaicing, denoising, deblurring, tone mapping and classification; replaces isolated perceptual tuning with downstream task supervision on simulated and captured data.

name: ISP Distillation
official_title: ISP Distillation
classification_basis: To skip ISP without losing pretrained recognition knowledge, distills predictions from an RGB teacher into a RAW-input student using unlabeled paired captures; adapts the input domain without new human annotations.

name: Lightweight HDR ISP
official_title: Lightweight HDR Camera ISP for Robust Perception in Dynamic Illumination Conditions via Fourier Adversarial Networks
classification_basis: To maintain perception across illumination, sequentially balances light and removes noise using frequency priors; Fourier-spectrum adversarial learning regularizes a compact CNN and evaluates detection/segmentation effects.

name: LOD
official_title: Crafting Object Detection in Very Low Light
classification_basis: To study detection in very low light, captures paired low-/normal-light RAW images with object annotations and evaluates sensor-domain processing; provides a benchmark linking illumination restoration choices to detector performance.

name: MAET
official_title: Multitask AET with Orthogonal Tangent Regularity for Dark Object Detection
classification_basis: To separate object content from illumination degradation, jointly learns detection and auto-encoding transformations with orthogonal tangent regularization; uses synthetic low-light formation to train from ordinary labeled detection datasets.

name: Matching in the Dark
official_title: Matching in the Dark: A Dataset for Matching Image Pairs of Low-light Scenes
classification_basis: To benchmark local matching under extreme darkness, provides paired RAW scenes in MID and compares eight enhancement methods with eleven matching pipelines; studies whether preserved sensor precision improves feature correspondence.

name: Optical Flow in the Dark
official_title: Optical Flow in the Dark
classification_basis: To avoid enhancement breaking motion consistency, trains optical flow directly on noisy low-light images using physically synthesized RAW noise; contributes a real RAW benchmark spanning exposure levels.

name: ISP4ML
official_title: ISP4ML: Understanding the Role of Image Signal Processing in Efficient Deep Learning Vision Systems
classification_basis: To quantify which imaging stages matter to classification, simulates a configurable sensor/ISP and trains ImageNet CNNs across pipeline settings; measures accuracy against processing cost to guide efficient vision design.

name: Reconfiguring Pipeline
official_title: Reconfiguring the Imaging Pipeline for Computer Vision
classification_basis: To save vision-system energy, tests eight algorithms with reversible imaging simulation and proposes configurable photography/vision modes; adjustable resolution and ADC precision enable an ISP-free low-power sensor configuration.

name: POS-ISP
official_title: POS-ISP: Pipeline Optimization at the Sequence Level for Task-aware ISP
classification_basis: To avoid repeated sequential pipeline execution during search, predicts the full ISP module sequence and parameters in one pass; sequence-level reinforcement learning uses only terminal task rewards without intermediate supervision.

name: ChameleonTuner
official_title: ChameleonTuner: Automatic ISP Color Tuning in Subjective Scenarios
classification_basis: To tune color despite viewpoint and field-of-view mismatch, establishes region-level color correspondences and searches a dedicated 3D-LUT parameter space with multiple objectives; enables interpretable subjective color tuning without pixel-aligned references.

name: Language Color ISP Tuning
official_title: Language-based Color ISP Tuning
classification_basis: To translate text descriptions into color settings, implements differentiable ISP blocks and minimizes a pretrained vision-language model's image–text objective by gradient descent; tunes conventional rendering parameters to the requested visual style.

name: MLLM ISP Tuning
official_title: Multimodal Large Language Model-Guided ISP Hyperparameter Optimization with Dynamic Preference Learning
classification_basis: To make ISP search sensitive to scene semantics and quality, incorporates MLLM-generated text descriptors and aligns preferences through DPO with dynamic pair generation; reduces manual preference labeling during hyperparameter optimization.

name: RL Photo-Finishing Tuning
official_title: Goal Conditioned Reinforcement Learning for Photo Finishing Tuning
classification_basis: To tune nondifferentiable finishing pipelines efficiently, trains a goal-image-conditioned reinforcement-learning policy that treats rendering as a black box; iteratively predicts parameters for aligned targets or style references without a differentiable proxy.

name: Sequence-Specific ISP Prior
official_title: Learning to Exploit the Sequence-Specific Prior Knowledge for Image Processing Pipelines Optimization
classification_basis: To avoid treating ISP parameters as an unstructured vector, sequentially predicts hyperparameters using module ordering and parameter similarities; evaluates the structured predictor for detection, segmentation and image-quality objectives.

name: Attention-aware ISP Tuning
official_title: Attention-Aware Learning for Hyperparameter Prediction in Image Processing Pipelines
classification_basis: To replace one fixed setting for all images, learns a multi-attention mapping from RAW content to ISP parameter space with downstream-task feedback; predicts image-specific settings for detection, segmentation and human viewing.

name: DRL-ISP
official_title: DRL-ISP: Multi-Objective Camera ISP with Deep Reinforcement Learning
classification_basis: To adapt processing to different vision objectives, a deep-RL agent repeatedly selects among 51 learned/conventional ISP tools using task-specific rewards; learns both the processing sequence and the choice of restoration/color operations.

name: Neural Photo-Finishing
official_title: Neural Photo-Finishing
classification_basis: To retain fine-grained controls while enabling gradients, concatenates tailored neural proxies of individual legacy finishing steps; supports image/video style transfer, ISP slider regression and photography-driven neural demosaicing.

name: HDR Pipeline Opt.
official_title: End-to-End High Dynamic Range Camera Pipeline Optimization
classification_basis: To optimize HDR imaging for downstream tasks, jointly tunes ISP hyperparameters and detector weights with mixed zeroth-/first-order block-coordinate descent; augments RAW with emulated SNR-transition artifacts to account for sensor behavior.

name: ReconfigISP
official_title: ReconfigISP: Reconfigurable Camera Image Processing Pipeline
classification_basis: To adapt pipeline structure as well as parameters, trains differentiable proxies for conventional ISP modules and applies differentiable architecture search; proxy tuning maintains accuracy while optimizing sensor-, task- and efficiency-specific configurations.

name: RL Self-Enhancing ISP
official_title: Reinforcement Learning of Self Enhancing Camera Image and Signal Processing
classification_basis: To remove heterogeneous patch artifacts, clusters variational-autoencoder features and trains a soft actor–critic agent to transform noisy patches toward nearby clean subspaces; recursive self-enhancement and reward-based deblocking refine the result.

name: HW-in-the-loop ISP
official_title: Hardware-in-the-loop End-to-end Optimization of Camera Image Processing Pipelines
classification_basis: To tune actual hardware without proxy errors, interfaces a zeroth-order stochastic multiobjective solver directly with the ISP; optimizes domain-specific losses for detection, segmentation or viewing using hardware-in-the-loop feedback.

name: Differentiable Proxies
official_title: Hyperparameter Optimization in Black-box Image Processing using Differentiable Proxies
classification_basis: To optimize black-box ISP settings for arbitrary objectives, trains a CNN mapping configuration space directly to evaluation metrics with hardware-in-the-loop; first-order search avoids explicitly approximating each lower-level image transformation.

name: ISP IQ Tuning
official_title: Automatic ISP Image Quality Tuning using Non-linear Optimization
classification_basis: To reduce expert tuning effort across ISP blocks, combines nonlinear optimization with automatic reference generation and image-quality objectives; treats denoising, demosaicing and sharpening implementations as black boxes.

name: EMOVIS
official_title: EMOVIS: Emotion-Optimized Image Processing
classification_basis: To support expressive rather than solely fidelity-driven rendering, maps four target emotions to saturation, local tone, sharpness and other ISP controls using a calibration study; integrates these adjustments into conventional hardware stages.

name: PQDynamicISP
official_title: PQDynamicISP: Dynamically Controlled Image Signal Processor for Any Image Sensors Pursuing Perceptual Quality
classification_basis: To improve conventional ISP expressiveness without a full neural renderer, dynamically predicts global and local parameters of lightweight processing functions; one controlled pipeline adapts to image content and different sensors.

name: NTIRE 2026 Unpaired ISP
official_title: NTIRE 2026 Challenge on Learned Smartphone ISP with Unpaired Data: Methods and Results
classification_basis: To benchmark ISP learning without matched captures, introduces UP-ISP with over 900 Pixel 6 scenes and a common RAW-to-sRGB protocol; reports the official baseline and competing unpaired training strategies.

name: AIM 2025 LL RAW Video
official_title: AIM 2025 Low-light RAW Video Denoising Challenge: Dataset, Methods and Results
classification_basis: To evaluate sensor-specific temporal denoising, provides 756 ten-frame sequences from 14 phone sensors with burst-averaged references; ranks Bayer-preserving final-frame outputs using PSNR/SSIM across light/exposure conditions.

name: AIM 2025 RAW Denoise
official_title: AIM 2025 Challenge on Real-World RAW Image Denoising
classification_basis: To test synthetic-data-driven denoising across cameras, benchmarks real low-light RAW from five DSLRs; compares noise synthesis, architectures and training using both full-reference fidelity and no-reference quality metrics.

name: Low-light ISP Survey (2025)
official_title: A Comprehensive Survey on Image Signal Processing Approaches for Low-Illumination Image Enhancement
classification_basis: To organize low-illumination enhancement methods, reviews traditional, deep-learning and hybrid processing approaches; compares how they handle brightness, contrast, noise and detail within an ISP-oriented taxonomy.

name: MAI 2025 ISP
official_title: Learned Smartphone ISP on Mobile GPUs, Mobile AI 2025 Challenge: Report
classification_basis: To assess deployable learned smartphone ISP, reviews mobile-GPU RAW-to-RGB challenge methods and their quality/runtime trade-offs; documents the benchmark and competing pipeline designs rather than introducing one standalone model.

name: NTIRE 2025 Night
official_title: NTIRE 2025 Challenge on Night Photography Rendering
classification_basis: To compare night rendering against a professional-camera reference, captures smartphone/camera pairs through a beam splitter; evaluates objective PSNR/SSIM and viewer similarity scores, documenting the competing neural/conventional pipelines.

name: NTIRE 2025 RAW Restoration
official_title: NTIRE 2025 Challenge on RAW Image Restoration and Super-Resolution
classification_basis: To benchmark blind sensor-domain restoration, defines RAW denoising/deblurring and 2× Bayer SR tasks under unknown degradations; reviews submitted methods and results for integration into camera pipelines.

name: NTIRE 2025 RGB→RAW
official_title: RAW Image Reconstruction from RGB on Smartphones. NTIRE 2025 Challenge Report
classification_basis: To generate smartphone RAW without capture metadata, benchmarks inverse ISP from matching sRGB images; documents the reconstruction dataset, baseline and submitted efficient models for reusable RAW-data synthesis.

name: MIPI 2024 Demosaic
official_title: MIPI 2024 Challenge on Demosaic for HybridEVS Camera: Methods and Results
classification_basis: To evaluate HybridEVS reconstruction with interleaved event pixels, benchmarks RAW-to-color demosaicing solutions and compares their reconstruction strategies; documents a sensor-specific challenge rather than a general image-restoration backbone.

name: MIPI 2024 Few-shot Denoise
official_title: MIPI 2024 Challenge on Few-shot RAW Image Denoising: Methods and Results
classification_basis: To reduce camera-calibration data requirements, benchmarks few-shot RAW denoising under a shared challenge protocol; reviews submitted noise modeling, adaptation and reconstruction solutions and their measured results.

name: NTIRE 2024 Night
official_title: NTIRE 2024 Challenge on Night Photography Rendering
classification_basis: To balance night-photo quality and mobile efficiency, evaluates smartphone RAW rendering by viewer preference and execution time; reports separate quality/efficiency nominations and the top processing pipelines.

name: NTIRE 2024 RAW SR
official_title: Deep RAW Image Super-Resolution. A NTIRE 2024 Challenge Survey
classification_basis: To compare blind RAW super-resolution, tasks models with 2× Bayer upscaling under unknown blur/noise; reviews the top submissions using a shared evaluation setup for sensor-domain reconstruction.

name: ISP Survey (2023)
official_title: ISP meets Deep Learning: A Survey on Deep Learning Methods for Image Signal Processing
classification_basis: To connect learned ISP stages with full pipelines, surveys deep methods for demosaicing, denoising and enhancement alongside end-to-end RAW rendering; compares datasets/results and identifies limitations for future research.

name: MIPI 2023 RGBW Remosaic
official_title: MIPI 2023 Challenge on RGBW Remosaic: Methods and Results
classification_basis: To process RGBW sensors with existing Bayer pipelines, benchmarks joint remosaicing/denoising and compares top methods using PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS and distribution metrics; documents the challenge protocol and results.

name: NTIRE 2023 Night
official_title: NTIRE 2023 Challenge on Night Photography Rendering
classification_basis: To test night rendering with limited target-sensor data, supplies calibrated color-checker captures instead of a large training set; compares RAW-to-sRGB solutions through viewer and photographer preference rankings.

name: AIM 2022 Reverse ISP
official_title: Reversed Image Signal Processing and RAW Reconstruction. AIM 2022 Challenge Report
classification_basis: To recover sensor-like images from ordinary RGB without metadata, defines two smartphone inverse-ISP tracks; reports baselines and submitted RAW-reconstruction methods for downstream restoration-data generation.

name: MAI 2022 ISP
official_title: Learned Smartphone ISP on Mobile GPUs with Deep Learning, Mobile AI & AIM 2022 Challenge: Report
classification_basis: To optimize neural ISP for real phone GPUs, benchmarks TensorFlow Lite models on paired UltraISP data and Snapdragon 8 Gen 1 hardware; reports rendering fidelity alongside measured mobile latency.

name: MIPI 2022 Quad Remosaic
official_title: MIPI 2022 Challenge on Quad-Bayer Re-mosaic: Dataset and Report
classification_basis: To reuse Bayer pipelines with Quad sensors, defines full-resolution Quad-to-Bayer interpolation jointly with denoising; contributes sensor data and a common challenge evaluation of submitted remosaicing methods.

name: MIPI 2022 RGBW Remosaic
official_title: MIPI 2022 Challenge on RGBW Sensor Re-mosaic: Dataset and Report
classification_basis: To convert RGBW sensor measurements into standard Bayer, benchmarks full-resolution remosaicing and denoising; supplies sensor-specific data and compares algorithms under a shared reconstruction protocol.

name: NTIRE 2022 Burst SR
official_title: NTIRE 2022 Burst Super-Resolution Challenge
classification_basis: To compare multiframe reconstruction, requires 4× RGB output from noisy RAW bursts, jointly testing denoising/demosaicing/SR; separates pixel-aligned synthetic data from real handheld bursts with approximate DSLR references.

name: NTIRE 2022 Night
official_title: NTIRE 2022 Challenge on Night Photography Rendering
classification_basis: To assess subjective night rendering, evaluates RAW-to-sRGB outputs using mean viewer opinions followed by professional-photographer ranking; documents thirteen teams' pipelines and their visual-quality results.

name: MAI 2021 ISP
official_title: Learned Smartphone ISP on Mobile NPUs with Deep Learning, Mobile AI 2021 Challenge: Report
classification_basis: To measure learned ISP on mobile NPUs, provides Sony Quad-Bayer RAW/medium-format RGB pairs and evaluates NPU-compatible models; reports both reconstruction fidelity and actual full-HD processing latency.

name: NTIRE 2021 Burst SR
official_title: NTIRE 2021 Challenge on Burst Super-Resolution: Methods and Results
classification_basis: To benchmark 4× reconstruction from noisy RAW bursts, separates synthetic and real-handheld tracks; compares alignment, fusion and reconstruction designs for joint denoising, demosaicing and super-resolution.

name: AIM 2020 ISP
official_title: AIM 2020 Challenge on Learned Image Signal Processing Pipeline
classification_basis: To benchmark learned phone-to-DSLR rendering, maps Huawei P20 RAW to Canon references and combines fidelity metrics with user-study perception; reviews submitted demosaicing, restoration and color-mapping pipelines.

name: NTIRE 2020 Real Denoising
official_title: NTIRE 2020 Challenge on Real Image Denoising: Dataset, Methods and Results
classification_basis: To compare real-noise removal in sensor and display spaces, introduces SIDD+ evaluation data and separate Bayer/sRGB tracks; reviews submitted models under a shared denoising protocol.

name: AIM 2019 RAW→RGB
official_title: AIM 2019 Challenge on RAW to RGB Mapping: Methods and Results
classification_basis: To establish real smartphone-to-DSLR ISP evaluation, benchmarks RAW-to-RGB reconstruction combining demosaicing, denoising and color rendering; documents participating solutions and fidelity/perceptual results on cross-camera data.

name: NTIRE 2019 Real Denoising
official_title: NTIRE 2019 Challenge on Real Image Denoising: Methods and Results
classification_basis: To evaluate real smartphone denoising consistently, defines SIDD-based RAW and sRGB tracks; compares submitted networks and training strategies using common test images and quantitative reconstruction metrics.

name: RAW vs RGB Restoration Benchmark
official_title: Benchmarking RAW and RGB Restoration in Image Signal Processors
classification_basis: To separate restoration placement from training alignment, compares pre-ISP RAW and post-ISP RGB models across devices, ISPs and noise/blur regimes; shows ISP-aware RGB supervision can outperform generic placement choices.

name: Reference-free ISP Evaluation
official_title: A Reference-Free Framework for Evaluating Single-Frame ISP Pipelines
classification_basis: To estimate pipeline quality without a clean image, predicts a proxy sRGB reference from output/ISO and computes standard full-reference metrics against it; lightweight LoRA adapts the evaluator when ISP components change.

name: Small-Pixel Neural ISP
official_title: The Need for Neural ISP in the Small-Pixel Era: How Shrinking Pixels Push Optics to the Limit and Neural Restoration Pushes Back
classification_basis: To test whether neural restoration compensates shrinking pixels, simulates a telephoto module at five pixel pitches and compares stagewise versus learned ISP; analyzes residual optical aberrations and low-SNR multiframe recovery.
